subject: We're So Close
body:
| [ ](http://www.action4liberty.com/?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=bogus_cfb_attack_follow_up&n=1)
---
Peter \-- **Trump. Was. Raided.** We live in dangerous times, Patriots. That said, there were bright spots here in Minnesota with Tuesday night's primary victories. However, the Swamp is forever lurking. The State House and Senate will definitely change for the better now that better quality, grassroots, conservative candidates won their primaries. But as you can imagine, that just puts a BIGGER target on our back. When they can't beat the grassroots movement at the polls, they'll try to destroy us in other ways - just like with Trump. And to be perfectly honest, I don't know how far the Political Class is willing to take things these days. After all, the FBI just raided President Trump's private residence.
## THAT SHOULD BE A BIG WAKE UP CALL!
If you remember back to a month ago, I mentioned how your Action 4 Liberty is being targeted by the Political Class with a bogus campaign finance complaint. The Republican Party's lawyer is behind the complaint. The Campaign Finance Board (CFB) staff, who are professional people, wrote a draft opinion to the Board stating that there is no probable cause that we did something wrong. But the Walz Appointed Board members rejected it and decided to take the political route and **go on a Democrat-style political witch hunt.** You can imagine that political appointees of Tim Walz are no fans of Action 4 Liberty. We pray that they conduct themselves ethically, unlike the DOJ in Trump's raid. This attack on us requires legal expenditures. This could go all the way to the Supreme Court. Which costs thousands just to clear our name. We will do everything in our power to protect this big movement you and I have built. (Thank you for all of your help) **Because if they can destroy the largest, conservative, grassroots organization in Minnesota, they can destroy anyone. If we're gone - no one is left holding these lying politicians accountable.** One month ago when I broke this news to you, I took a long shot and set a $30,000 goal for a Legal Defense Fund. Well, I'm happy to report we are only $1,285 away from hitting that goal. Can you imagine the statement that makes to our enemies if we hit the goal?! It shows you have our back when it was needed the most! [](https://www.action4liberty.com/a4l_legal_fund?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=bogus_cfb_attack_follow_up&n=2) **I'm begging you, help me raise the final $1,285 so we can hit our goal in only a month's time. Can I count on you?** | [](https://www.action4liberty.com/a4l_legal_fund?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=bogus_cfb_attack_follow_up&n=3 "Donate") [Donate](https://www.action4liberty.com/a4l_legal_fund?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=bogus_cfb_attack_follow_up&n=3)
---
To be truly effective in politics, there's no way of avoiding catching flak. It just means that we're over the target.
Tuesday's primary results are why we are such a threat to the Political Establishment.
They don't want grassroots, conservative candidates. They just want swampy legislators who will do whatever the Party Bosses tell them to do.
**And that's EXACTLY why we are losing our country and our state...**
or why we WERE losing our country and state.
You see, I know that we will turn things around. With real leaders like Nathan Wesenberg in the senate and Erik Mortensen in the House, it will fundamentally change the direction of politics in Minnesota.
The media and the Political Class are starting to sense it. Which means they'll keep coming after us.
Story after story are coming out in the media already trying to weave a narrative how fighting for our freedom is radical. They are trying to browbeat the weak St. Paul Republicans into line for their Progress Leftist agenda.
This is why I really need your help. We MUST FIGHT BACK!
We're only $1,285 from hitting our goal. That's only 26 people giving $50. Or 13 people giving $100. Or, if someone can, one person giving $1,285.
Can I count on you to get us to our goal by the weekend?
[**Please help me today with a donation to our Legal Fund. $25, $50, $100, $500 or $1,285 goes a long way in helping us defend this massive movement we've built**](https://www.action4liberty.com/a4l_legal_fund?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=bogus_cfb_attack_follow_up&n=4).
**In Liberty,**
****

body: (Washington, DC) – Judicial Watch announced today that Magistrate Judge Bruce Reinhart has ordered the U.S. Department of Justice to file a response to Judicial Watch’s Motion to Unseal the warrant and supporting materials behind the FBI raid of President Donald Trump’s home in Mar-a-Lago by 5p.m. on August 15, 2022. [Action] Judge Orders DOJ to Respond to Judicial Watch’s Motion to Unseal Mar-a-Lago Search Warrant Materials by 5p.m. EST on August 15 [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59745&L=27833&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvanVkZ2Utb3JkZXJzLWRvai11bnNlYWwtbWFyLWEtbGFnby1zZWFyY2gtd2FycmFudC8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1hY3Rpb24rYWxlcnQmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==] [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59745&L=27833&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvanVkZ2Utb3JkZXJzLWRvai11bnNlYWwtbWFyLWEtbGFnby1zZWFyY2gtd2FycmFudC8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1hY3Rpb24rYWxlcnQmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==] (Washington, DC) – Judicial Watch announced today that Magistrate Judge Bruce Reinhart has ordered the U.S. Department of Justice to file a response to Judicial Watch’s Motion to Unseal the warrant and supporting materials behind the FBI raid of President Donald Trump’s home in Mar-a-Lago by 5p.m. on August 15, 2022. body:

Peter,

I know something about tough battles. This primary was a tough fight. Fighting and beating breast cancer was a tough fight. Running and growing a Michigan-based steel company, as a woman, was tough. Watching my Nana locked away and left to die in a nursing home was tough.

_But as the saying goes, when the times get tough, the tough get going. I am tough, and I am just getting going._

With America First patriots like YOU fighting alongside me, we're going to take back our state from the radical Left and lay the groundwork to take back the White House in 2024.

The battlelines in this race couldn't be any clearer. This is going to be an epic fight between a conservative businesswoman and mother, and a far-Left birthing parent and career politician.

**_To win, I 'm going to need your support, Peter. I don't have liberal megadonors like Whitmer. Grassroots conservatives like you are all I've got. _**

Peter,

Every morning I wake up, determined to get the most out of each day. I'm an optimist and firmly believe it takes more effort to have a bad day than a good one.

But I've got to tell you, MSNBC and their cast of far-Left characters do their best to ruin my day as often as they can. You might recall that earlier this year one of their regular panelists began attacking our Senate campaign.

In April, he called me an **" ignorant neophyte,"** and said that my candidacy is **" a white insult to Black people."**

Then he called Senator Tim Scott and me _**" tokens"**_ who are _**" shucking and jiving for their white handlers."** _

Now, he's back at it again, saying this about me on MSNBC earlier this week:

| _**" Walker is doing what he's told, and that is what Republicans like. That's what Republicans want from their negroes: to do what they're told."**_
---

I'll repeat what I said in April: **this is racist, disgusting, and sad.**

What's also disturbing is that our opponent, who also happens to be Black, has never once condemned any of these blatantly racist remarks. _Can you imagine if these comments were made by a conservative about a Black Democrat? The outrage would be instantaneous and overwhelming - and rightly so._

[View this message in your browser](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zvgfhavph9getk3dd0p4r5ji5uk0jlofobino0to_rp22sh2s8i66or0c9ie1ob1c9h238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuij78bielqr0sbiegqb7ctl6tr779hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4ongmpgncs366hjbapr4cpr60tlieop30or3c5ib8o9kmlq75clnmiq61c5j6qpj0puie1p68dhgm9j74t1hepge1d3563gbacb4spj6cc9n6dgm0tr0cpqmeddhcuobapbi4no)

Friend,

If a death threat was made against a Leftist Democrat on social media, it would be deleted, and whoever posted it would be banned...

But hypocrisy is the name of the game, as threats against conservative SCOTUS Justices and pro-life pregnancy centers are allowed on Twitter with ZERO consequences.

Fox News recently released an article about recent threats made on Twitter, citing our research done at the Media Research Center.

**" The conservative Media Research Center found 67 posts threatening or calling for violence against Supreme Court Justices from June 24 through July 8 alone, representing the two-week period immediately following the court's opinion in Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health Organization, the case that overturned the landmark abortion case Roe v. Wade."
--Brian Flood**

The men and women being threatened should not be persecuted for simply doing their jobs and speaking out about their beliefs. And it's time for Twitter to hold its users accountable for threatening assassination, use of Molotov cocktails, and more.

Let me introduce myself. My name is Brent Bozell, and I am the Founder and President of the Media Research Center (MRC). MRC is the only conservative organization dedicated to exposing the radical left-wing agenda in the media.

**When the MRC was founded in 1987, over 75% of Americans trusted the left-wing media. Since then, MRC has successfully SHATTERED America's trust in the left-wing media--over 90% of Americans state they DO NOT trust the media anymore. **

As Internet Accountability Project founder Mike Davis said,_ "Just imagine if a group of White nationalists harassed and intimidated Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson while she's deciding the upcoming affirmative action case at the Supreme Court. These big tech platforms have gatekeeping power over information and commerce online, and it is long past time for Republican lawmakers to put constituents first instead of their big tech donors, and break up these big tech monopolists."_

[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2znsg3h79ihv7s891esigh2ffb50uloiluq6llot0_rp22sh2s8i66or0c9ie1ob1c9h2bs)

That's why MRC is fighting against corruption and bias in the media and Big Tech. Here's our plan:

1. The MRC monitors and clips videos of all content from major networks, social media accounts, and news outlets.

2. My team and I analyze this content and identify fake news stories, lies, and media bias.

3. MRC's team exposes these lies by forcing the media to report the story, sharing their reports on social media, and telling the truth.

The Media Research Center also owns some of the largest social media pages in the conservative movement so that they can share these stories with supporters.

**MRC successfully destroyed the reputation of biased liberal media, and we 'll do the same to Big Tech.**

Elon Musk recently bought Twitter, and he's fighting to protect Free Speech on the platform.

But he is inheriting a Big Tech machine designed to censor and suppress conservative voices such as the Media Research Center, the Babylon Bee, President Trump, and more.

subject: Holding Lawless, Woke Prosecutors Accountable (READ)
body:
**[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60985002:J0pLIAVNL:m:1:3317145305:3861895AD1C00665534CF1B839B0B7CB:r)**

Peter,
You've seen across the country a wave of woke prosecutors funded by out of state interests refusing to uphold the rule of law who are allowing criminals to walk free without ever facing consequences for their crimes. As Governor, I have made it clear: **In this state, we uphold the rule of law. We respect the law enforcement officers who put their lives on the line every day to keep our communities safe.**

We DO NOT allow woke activist prosecutors to abdicate their duty to do their job and protect their communities. This is why I took action to right the wrongs of a prosecutor whose conduct has fallen below the standard that is required by the Florida Constitution by refusing to enforce laws he doesn't like. A prosecutor is not a law unto himself.

**_[[UPHOLD THE RULE OF LAW]](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60985002:J0pLIAVNL:m:1:3317145305:3861895AD1C00665534CF1B839B0B7CB:r "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=645171481de93327bc960403d9d6cbc7bf571d819c9300408453fabc7720711dfcdc8d6d712f8c75a5fe90ab67d379481cf2fa49bfdf629a")_**

We are not going to allow this pathogen of ignoring the law that's been going on around the country to get a foothold in the state of Florida. We are going to make sure that our laws are enforced and that no individual prosecutor puts themselves above the law.

It's simple. If you put yourself above the law, you are violating and neglecting your duty and you are displaying a lack of competence to be able to perform those duties. If you abandon the duties of your oath of office, you no longer have the right to hold that office.

The crime in places like San Francisco and Los Angeles is out of control. Police are unable to do their jobs, businesses are closing up shop, and violent criminals are walking free all because of the dereliction of duty by prosecutors who are funded by ideological activists. In Florida, we're not going to sit idly by and watch our state spiral into chaos. We're going to respect our law enforcement officers, we're going to protect our citizens, and we're going to enforce the law.

As your Governor, I will not stand for woke prosecutors, who are entrusted with enforcing the law, showing more deference and care for criminals than the victims of their crimes in the name of "social justice." Denying a victim their day in court is not justice. Allowing a criminal to walk free of consequences for their crimes is not justice. It is, in fact, the opposite of justice.

**_[[REJECT WOKE PROSECUTORS]](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60985002:J0pLIAVNL:m:1:3317145305:3861895AD1C00665534CF1B839B0B7CB:r "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=645171481de93327e26993ba67113f8689f06e8ca94ebda36bd320efd24e432ee79049f01519eca11f1dc046e8b3a44077fbaced8a682f9a")_**

Florida is a law-and-order state. I am not going to back down from that one inch. The radical Left is already attacking me for doing my job to ensure that the laws are enforced in our state. They are going to use my suspension of a state attorney refusing to do his job to appeal to the members of the woke mob and add to their war chest.

Like I've said before, Peter, I will never allow political favor to sway my resolve to do what's right. I need to know that I can count on your support as I prepare to go head-on against the Democrats' crusade against law and order. **_[Are you with me?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60985002:J0pLIAVNL:m:1:3317145305:3861895AD1C00665534CF1B839B0B7CB:r "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=645171481de933275f93e2240482fd3499e8163be20c6fbccf3cfae8ca859ecc3f7e5669955f9d09276a697c2b71a24aa50c2e825ad8b5ba")_**

Hello,
My mother worked alongside my dad in Lebanon Farm Shop well into their 70s. They refused assistance from their many children even after they lost their life savings in the Savings and Loan debacle of the 1980s. My mom in coveralls, petite as she was, handing tools to my dad is an indelible image I carry with me to this day.
My dad built a business repairing farm implements. In a way, I think he hoped that I’d stick around and take it over, but that wasn’t to be. I joined the Navy after getting a scholarship and my life as a machinist and welder came to a close.
Dad said very little about his service in the Second World War. He had the burns and shrapnel of his first ship sinking, and would provide some quips about surviving a night amongst the flotsam and death off Guadalcanal, but he didn’t dissuade me from enlisting. My mom had the bravery in saying quite simply, “The healthy bird flees the nest.” She wiped her eyes on her apron as I drove up the hill on my way to ‘boot camp.’ It took me some time to understand why.
You could say my mom and dad embodied rural Iowa values in their unique ways: Family, hard work, sacrifice, education, and honesty. And I think of them every day on the campaign trail, because it’s those values that drove me to run for political office.
**After nearly 4 decades serving in the United States Navy, I’m running for Senate against Chuck Grassley because it’s time politicians in Washington fight for everyday people like my folks.**
The early polls all show this will be a close race, so of course, I’m facing down millions of dollars in Super PAC attacks. I don’t come from some political dynasty, and I’m not taking corporate PAC money. Instead, I’m relying entirely on the donations of generous grassroots donors like you.
**There’s less than 24 hours until our next critical fundraising deadline, and right now we’re still short of our $25,000 goal and what we need to defeat Chuck Grassley and win. So I have to ask:**

If you believe you received this message in error or wish to no longer receive email from us, please. Hello, My mother worked alongside my dad in Lebanon Farm Shop well into their 70s. They refused assistance from their many children even after they lost their life savings in the Savings and Loan debacle of the 1980s. My mom in coveralls, petite as she was, handing tools to my dad is an indelible image I carry with me to this day. My dad built a business repairing farm implements. In a way, I think he hoped that I’d stick around and take it over, but that wasn’t to be. I joined the Navy after getting a scholarship and my life as a machinist and welder came to a close. Dad said very little about his service in the Second World War. He had the burns and shrapnel of his first ship sinking, and would provide some quips about surviving a night amongst the flotsam and death off Guadalcanal, but he didn’t dissuade me from enlisting. My mom had the bravery in saying quite simply, “The healthy bird flees the nest.” She wiped her eyes on her apron as I drove up the hill on my way to ‘boot camp.’ It took me some time to understand why. You could say my mom and dad embodied rural Iowa values in their unique ways: Family, hard work, sacrifice, education, and honesty. And I think of them every day on the campaign trail, because it’s those values that drove me to run for political office. After nearly 4 decades serving in the United States Navy, I’m running for Senate against Chuck Grassley because it’s time politicians in Washington fight for everyday people like my folks. The early polls all show this will be a close race, so of course, I’m facing down millions of dollars in Super PAC attacks. I don’t come from some political dynasty, and I’m not taking corporate PAC money. Instead, I’m relying entirely on the donations of generous grassroots donors like you. There’s less than 24 hours until our next critical fundraising deadline, and right now we’re still short of our $25,000 goal and what we need to defeat Chuck Grassley and win. name: EMERGENCY ALERT
subject: [BREAKING] Cease-Fire May End
body:
The Red Alert app on my phone is sounding feverishly. Town after town in Israel is on high alert!

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60984747:J4SsdAV5N:m:1:3253819041:91AD838040D3FB57F034D8370E945574:r "Headline") Peter: If you're following the news, you know this the people of Israel have endured a few tough days and more may be coming. The Iran-backed Islamic Jihad released a barrage of nearly 1000 rocket attacks targeting Israeli citizens. [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60984747:J4SsdAV5N:m:1:3253819041:91AD838040D3FB57F034D8370E945574:r "Phone")**These rockets have been fired at Jerusalem, Tel Aviv, and other Israeli cities. These attacks have taken place day and night, disrupting sleep for most Israelis who must seek immediate shelter.** **As I write you, the Red Alert app on my phone is sounding feverishly. Town after town is on high alert!** **These acts of terrorism are increasing by the day. Even when it's quiet after a cease-fire, the threat of more rockets and trauma from the past rockets remains. That 's why I am asking you to help us raise $45,798.25 by midnight tonight so we may:**
* Provide emergency aid backpacks for local Israeli security forces.
* Comfort terror victims suffering from PTSD especially young children.
* Care for soldiers who put their lives on the line to protect their people and the Land.

**[Please donate $25, $50, or even $100 and help us provide these emergency supplies to those in need. A blessing in ANY AMOUNT is greatly appreciated.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60984747:J4SsdAV5N:m:1:3253819041:91AD838040D3FB57F034D8370E945574:r "Please donate $25, $50, or even $100 and help us provide these emergency supplies to those in need. A blessing in ANY AMOUNT is greatly
appreciated.")** We definitely need prayers, but we also need financial help so the Genesis123 Foundation can fulfill its mission and aid those who have suffered as a result of these rocket attacks. Most of Israel's youth (including my son) put their lives on the line defending the State of Israel and by playing a vital role in the War on Terror that threatens Israel, the United States, and our allies. [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60984747:J4SsdAV5N:m:1:3253819041:91AD838040D3FB57F034D8370E945574:r "Soldiers")Unfortunately, often these soldiers do not have all the supplies they need, and often times their families have to buy them supplies out of their own pockets. Sadly, this isn't an option for soldiers who don't have family or the means to support them, so the Genesis 123 Foundation fills that gap while they keep defending Israel, safely and with dignity. During this Summer's extreme heatwave, one of the ways we help is to provide cold drinks, sweet watermelon and ice cream, and anything else we can, to help ease the soldiers' burdens. And let me tell you, these cool refreshments in the hot Summer sun are a well-received relief to these soldiers. **[Whether it's to help us provide cold refreshments or life-saving medical equipment, we need your help to serve people and soldiers in Israel. Please stand with us today as we provide emergency supplies to those in need with your tax-deductible donation of $50, $100, or $250 today!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60984747:J4SsdAV5N:m:1:3253819041:91AD838040D3FB57F034D8370E945574:r "Whether it’s to help us provide cold refreshments or life-saving medical equipment, we need your help to serve people and soldiers in
Israel. Please stand with us today as we provide emergency supplies to those in need with your tax-deductible donation of $50, $100, or $250 today!")** Please prayerfully consider how you can help us take care of all the people affected by these Iranian-backed terror attacks. Don't delay. The next attack may occur in a matter of days as the Islamic Jihad is already threatening to break the ceasefire. The people of Israel need to be ready to respond to the emergencies and trauma that will result from the next attack, and that's why we need your generous support TODAY! Whether it's 10 or 1,000 rockets, the lives of innocent women and children are at risk. **We need to make sure the soldiers defending Israel have all they need, and we can provide other resources to Israelis who have suffered from these attacks.** **[Your donation of $100, $500, or even $1000 today will make the key difference in our ability to fulfill our mission with supplies and provide counseling to those Israelis who need the help as a result of these terrorist attacks.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60984747:J4SsdAV5N:m:1:3253819041:91AD838040D3FB57F034D8370E945574:r "Your donation of $100, $500, or even $1000
today will make the key difference in our ability to fulfill our mission with supplies and provide counseling to those Israelis who need the help as a
result of these terrorist attacks.")** Thank you again for your prayers and support. May God's blessings be upon Israel, Jonathan Feldstein
President, Genesis 123 Foundation

| The FBI sent agents to the home of a former president, the leading contender to be the Republican nominee for 2024. What happened to President Trump is OUTRAGEOUS, and it is another reminder of why it is so important Conservatives work hard to defend the Constitution and elect a Republican Congress this November. Democrats have flouted the law and abused power in order to go after President Trump ever since he went down the escalator. Now they want to hire 87 thousand IRS agents willing to "Carry a firearm and be willing to use deadly force, if necessary."
Please join us this Saturday, August 13, to show your support for President Donald Trump, and to protest the political weaponization of our government. A raid on a former president's residence has never happened to a former president before. The fact that this raid happened just 90 days before the midterm elections seems like a political "Hail Mary", and should outrage everyone. Wear your Trump gear and put American flags on your truck.
Details:
Date: Saturday 13 August
Time: 1-3pm
Where: Goochland: Outdoor lot across from Food Lion 30 Broad St. Rd., Manakin-Sabot, VA 23103
This event is sponsored by Delegate John McGuire, who is running for Virginia State Senate District 10 in 2023, and the Goochland Tea Party. It is open to anyone tired of government overreach.

We’ve kept you waiting long enough.

When A.G. Holder established this organization, the goal was to support fair maps that help enfranchise more Americans and uphold American democracy. We’ve had great success: this redistricting cycle has been the fairest in a generation in some states. And we’re continuing to fight in states that have ongoing redistricting battles.

**But what’s the point of pushing for fair maps if the voters aren’t able to utilize their right to vote?**

name: Cliff Schecter, Blue Amp Action
subject: Beto called someone laughing at kids’ dying from assault rifles a "Motherf***er." NPR's more upset about the swearing than the dead kids.
body:
NPR doesn’t get it
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | | | | Peter, NPR just doesn’t get it. **By now I’m sure you’ve seen the viral video of Beto O'Rourke responding to a Greg-Abbott supporting heckler as he talked about the somber reality of our children murdered by assault rifles. NPR saw it, and they were outraged ... by Beto swearing.** **_[THANK BETO for saying what must be said, and doing what must be done. Please join us in giving $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to Beto O'Rourke. Because we can't afford 2023 where he is not Governor of Texas.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T2ce421cd-e2d1-49ba-852d-075fb6aad228/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)_** **_If you're exhausted by Democrats too often refusing to hit back, comment or message aggressively against Republicans who lie, cheat, steal, coup, take away our rights and pocket our taxes, it's a reminder of why we need the next generation of fighters in the Democratic Party to take over, and oh my, is Beto O'Rourke one of those._** Beto was speaking about assault rifles, and how they were weapons made for the battlefield--which every sane human including the creator of the assault rifle has acknowledged--the damage they do to little bodies in schools as they were made to pierce helmets of opposing soldiers. In fetid, disrespectful, and honestly abominable right-wing fashion, as he was talking about children being murdered by assault rifles, he was heckled by a Greg Abbott supporter in the crowd who started laughing.** ** **_Laughing at kids dying via assault rifle. Think about that._** **Then Beto responded the way we all wish we had, not like some polished politician but a real human with real emotions:** **_" It may be funny to you motherf***er but it's not funny to me."_**
---

body:
https://secure.everyaction.com/DQ7Hxcpq3Eabel6LA-9V0Q2?refcode=newsletter [https://secure.everyaction.com/DQ7Hxcpq3Eabel6LA-9V0Q2?refcode=newsletter]
Are you election season ready, ? With the November 8th General Election less than 90 days away, here's a quick roundup of events, meetups, and trainings to help you and your fellow democracy defenders prepare for the most important election of our lifetime.
IMPORTANT DATES TO REMEMBER
October 24, 2022: Last day to REGISTER before the November election
November 1, 2022: Last day to apply for a mail-in or civilian absentee ballot
November 8, 2022: Last day for County Boards of Elections to receive voted mail-in and civilian absentee ballots (must be received by 8:00 P.M.)
To register to vote, check your registration status, or to make a voting plan, visit vote.pa [https://vote.pa/?org=npp] .
UPCOMING EVENTS
Netroots Nation 2022 | August 18-20
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AV001/1/90920/images/August%20Graphics%20%282%29%20%281%29.png]
We’re less than one week away from Netroots Nation 2022! Our CEO Kadida Kenner will be a guest panelist and moderator at this year’s gathering, so tweet us and let us know you're at #NN22 [https://www.facebook.com/hashtag/nn22?__eep__=6&__cft__[0]=AZV6L7W9Xdr7jNAkPZ-3G82zxqm_UyW47EWkvwSLG93UbgzJmjtMvtQyk6YhhyZpULJqfHBfDJQsj1zXNRXbDKdodTYyOUCgNNLvdgEcojlOS6E4kyaVapy-KdEQX2R-fpiuEAvkPjoZkLtPskO6mO5F_Yuhd3EYMAQ2CGkC3SzaLb8XdIwQMYP9QdKozsTMGwRa_dBoSuyvUKpZDEUF1bdH&__tn__=*NK-R] !
Demstock 2022 | August 26-28
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/414B72497853584C5636756B52726E50495244764871536A6D50506D3544715139727374576779642B774A486C61487833527336507755316676556A79725841/editor_images/Screen%20Shot%202022-08-11%20at%203.34.30%20PM.png]
Taking place at the Venango County Fairgrounds, Team NPP will be at Demstock 2022 this year!
For more information, visit demstock.net. [https://demstock.net/]
Volunteer Trainings
Wednesday, August 17: Introduction to Voter Registration
Our monthly training is for new volunteers who are ready to get involved and need to learn the basics of voter registration and existing volunteers who need a refresher.
REGISTER HERE [https://us06web.zoom.us/meeting/register/tZYrdO6trzkpE9AW7fqUCoFI6Tha2Oj4GmgH]
Wednesday, August 25: Overcoming Objections
This interactive, in-depth training focuses on making the ask to register voters, walking through objections and exploring how to handle those objections with responses that will turn into successful voter registrations.
REGISTER HERE [https://us06web.zoom.us/meeting/register/tZEpdO6tqD8tGtJVc3lzXgvRV8IlzBFDuUU7]
We're Registering Voters 365/24/7
We are empowering communities of color, immigrant communities and the youth to use their voice and vote their values. Will you join us and donate to fund the work we are doing across the Commonwealth and defend our democracy?
Invest in our democracy [https://secure.everyaction.com/DQ7Hxcpq3Eabel6LA-9V0Q2?emci=94765bbc-8d5e-ec11-94f6-0050f2e65e9b&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=1068162]

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Campbell for Congress
body:
https://www.voteheidicampbell.com/ [https://www.voteheidicampbell.com/]
Peter,
The race for the 5th Congressional District is heating up and it’s important for you to know more about Senator Campbell’s opponent, Andy Ogles.
Andy has been trying his luck as a far right politician in Tennessee for a very long time. He first ran for Congress in 2002, but was rejected by Republican voters. Later, he worked on Newt Gingrich’s presidential campaign and then for Americans for Prosperity. Yes, the Koch-funded super PAC that pushes trickle-down economics and other extreme policies that shortchange working families.
Ogles brags about his time working for the Koch’s when he lobbied the state legislature to give big corporations and Wall Street a huge new tax break. His “win” was a loss for local governments struggling to fund our public schools, fight crime and replace aging infrastructure.
In 2018, he flirted with the idea of challenging U.S. Sen. Bob Corker in a Republican Primary, but wimped out and decided to run for mayor of Maury County. He won and started calling himself Tennessee’s “most conservative” mayor.
Last month, he insulted local leaders by vetoing the entire county budget just to defund the library because he didn’t like a book display featuring LGBTQ writers.
We need Heidi Campbell so we can avoid a public disaster with Andy Ogles in Congress. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/campbellemail]
As a candidate for Congress, Ogles cheered when the Supreme Court overruled Roe v. Wade and gun safety laws. He says he wants to shut down the Dept. of Education, which provides key support for students with disabilities, teacher development and rural schools.
He has denied the results of the 2020 election and is already campaigning for Trump to run again. He is calling for President Biden’s impeachment.
In Congress, Andy Ogles is a guaranteed vote for a national ban on abortion and his record shows he won’t stand up for working families if it displeases his billionaire campaign donors.
It is time to stand up for Tennessee and say a resounding “NO” to Andy Ogles and his ultra MAGA agenda.
Stand with Heidi Campbell and fight for freedom for families first! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/campbellemail]
Our campaign is focused on solving problems and getting results. We can bring our fight for working and middle class families to Congress, but we need your help. This is a winnable race but it is going to be a knock down drag out fight all the way through November.
If you remember the nasty ads from just a few weeks ago in the GOP primary, just wait to see what Andy sends out going after Senator Campbell. Please chip in to fight back against the vicious attacks we know are coming! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/campbellemail]
Thanks,
Team Campbell

subject: I will be the 51st vote to codify Roe
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Trudy Busch Valentine for Senate
body:
Kansas voters showed us that folks are ready to fight for reproductive rights.
| | |
---
Peter, just a week ago, Kansas voters showed us that folks are ready to fight for reproductive rights, even in states that pundits have written off as impenetrable GOP strongholds.
The vote in Kansas was an incredible victory for abortion access and showed what is possible when folks take action. **Now, we need voters all across the country to bring that same heart and spirit to the ballot boxes in November.**
You see, the only way to truly restore reproductive freedom for _all_ Americans is by expanding our Senate majority so that we can finally codify Roe v. Wade.
If we don't take federal action to defend our right to choose, our country will continue down this dark path and cede more and more of Americans' remaining freedoms. Experts are warning that if abortion access is left to the states, legislators in states like mine could move to outlaw abortion care entirely, ban interstate travel for abortions, restrict birth control access, and criminalize the very act of seeking information about abortions.
**And if we let the GOP take back the Senate, conservative senators could even pass a nationwide abortion ban – outlawing abortion in all 50 states in one fell swoop. Make no mistake: If Eric Schmitt or John Wood win in November, they would help make this happen. **
A clear majority of Americans support legal access to abortion. We have to fight for them. This November, we _must_ expand our Senate majority by electing Democratic leaders who will protect reproductive freedom. **We can do that right here in Missouri, but only if grassroots activists like you stand with me:[Please, can you pitch in $5 tonight to send an unapologetically pro-choice leader to Washington? Now, we need voters all across the country to bring that same heart and spirit to the ballot boxes in November. You see, the only way to truly restore reproductive freedom for all Americans is by expanding our Senate majority so that we can finally codify Roe v. Wade. If we don't take federal action to defend our right to choose, our country will continue down this dark path and cede more and more of Americans' remaining freedoms. Experts are warning that if abortion access is left to the states, legislators in states like mine could move to outlaw abortion care entirely, ban interstate travel for abortions, restrict birth control access, and criminalize the very act of seeking information about abortions. And if we let the GOP take back the Senate, conservative senators could even pass a nationwide abortion ban – outlawing abortion in all 50 states in one fell swoop. Make no mistake: If Eric Schmitt or John Wood win in November, they would help make this happen. A clear majority of Americans support legal access to abortion. We have to fight for them. This November, we must expand our Senate majority by electing Democratic leaders who will protect reproductive freedom. Hi Peter,
Congress is on the brink of passing the most significant climate legislation we have ever seen. The Inflation Reduction Act is a critical step in confronting climate change and boosting our clean energy economy. It is no secret that climate change is impacting our communities, from eroding shorelines to hotter summers. We must do everything we can to reverse its effects for the sake of our community’s health and economy.
I will bring the success stories of our state to Congress. We are home to the first offshore wind farm ever in the United States. And the University of Rhode Island is home to one of the top oceanography institutions in the country. The list goes on from there.
But there is still more work to be done to address climate change. We must also prioritize making the transition to clean energy affordable and accessible so that all communities may benefit from a public health and economic perspective.

disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY DIEHL FOR MASSACHUSETTS
body:
| | | |
---
| South Dakota Governor Kristi Noem isn't one to mince words.
So, it's not surprising that when she was asked by the Boston news media for her assessment of the race for Massachusetts Governor, her answer was straightforward and decisive:
"Geoff's going to win."
---
Her answer wasn't just because Geoff and his running mate, Leah Allen, both won the Republican Convention in May (although they did). And it wasn't just because Geoff is leading his primary opponent by a three-to-one margin (which he is). It's because, as the Governor said, "leadership has consequences," and Geoff Diehl and Leah Allen are the only candidates in the race who can provide the leadership Massachusetts needs in 2023.
---
---
That leadership was also on display on The Kuhner Report this week, as Geoff was the only candidate in the race for Governor who had the courage and determination to sit down with "Boston's Bulldozer," Jeff Kuhner. Geoff's opponent declined an invitation to debate, so Geoff took advantage of more than an hour of air time to take questions from callers about his campaign, his vision for Massachusetts, and how he intends to fight for the People of Massachusetts.

subject: Florida is a law-and-order state and we will keep it that way.
body:
**[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60988990:J87taAVNc:m:1:3253819041:5B5CEDD6E66D7F6805E42D2767EA943B:r)**

Peter,
You've seen across the country a wave of woke prosecutors funded by out of state interests refusing to uphold the rule of law who are allowing criminals to walk free without ever facing consequences for their crimes. As Governor, I have made it clear: **In this state, we uphold the rule of law. We respect the law enforcement officers who put their lives on the line every day to keep our communities safe.**

We DO NOT allow woke activist prosecutors to abdicate their duty to do their job and protect their communities. This is why I took action to right the wrongs of a prosecutor whose conduct has fallen below the standard that is required by the Florida Constitution by refusing to enforce laws he doesn't like. A prosecutor is not a law unto himself.

**_[[UPHOLD THE RULE OF LAW]](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60988990:J87taAVNc:m:1:3253819041:5B5CEDD6E66D7F6805E42D2767EA943B:r "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=645171481de93327bc960403d9d6cbc7bf571d819c9300408453fabc7720711dfcdc8d6d712f8c75a5fe90ab67d379481cf2fa49bfdf629a")_**

We are not going to allow this pathogen of ignoring the law that's been going on around the country to get a foothold in the state of Florida. We are going to make sure that our laws are enforced and that no individual prosecutor puts themselves above the law.

It's simple. If you put yourself above the law, you are violating and neglecting your duty and you are displaying a lack of competence to be able to perform those duties. If you abandon the duties of your oath of office, you no longer have the right to hold that office.

The crime in places like San Francisco and Los Angeles is out of control. Police are unable to do their jobs, businesses are closing up shop, and violent criminals are walking free all because of the dereliction of duty by prosecutors who are funded by ideological activists. In Florida, we're not going to sit idly by and watch our state spiral into chaos. We're going to respect our law enforcement officers, we're going to protect our citizens, and we're going to enforce the law.

As your Governor, I will not stand for woke prosecutors, who are entrusted with enforcing the law, showing more deference and care for criminals than the victims of their crimes in the name of "social justice." Denying a victim their day in court is not justice. Allowing a criminal to walk free of consequences for their crimes is not justice. It is, in fact, the opposite of justice.

**_[[REJECT WOKE PROSECUTORS]](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60988990:J87taAVNc:m:1:3253819041:5B5CEDD6E66D7F6805E42D2767EA943B:r "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=645171481de93327e26993ba67113f8689f06e8ca94ebda36bd320efd24e432ee79049f01519eca11f1dc046e8b3a44077fbaced8a682f9a")_**

Florida is a law-and-order state. I am not going to back down from that one inch. The radical Left is already attacking me for doing my job to ensure that the laws are enforced in our state. They are going to use my suspension of a state attorney refusing to do his job to appeal to the members of the woke mob and add to their war chest.

Like I've said before, Peter, I will never allow political favor to sway my resolve to do what's right. clean_body: Peter, You've seen across the country a wave of woke prosecutors funded by out of state interests refusing to uphold the rule of law who are allowing criminals to walk free without ever facing consequences for their crimes. As Governor, I have made it clear: In this state, we uphold the rule of law. We respect the law enforcement officers who put their lives on the line every day to keep our communities safe. We DO NOT allow woke activist prosecutors to abdicate their duty to do their job and protect their communities. This is why I took action to right the wrongs of a prosecutor whose conduct has fallen below the standard that is required by the Florida Constitution by refusing to enforce laws he doesn't like. A prosecutor is not a law unto himself. [[UPHOLD THE RULE OF LAW]]( "") We are not going to allow this pathogen of ignoring the law that's been going on around the country to get a foothold in the state of Florida. We are going to make sure that our laws are enforced and that no individual prosecutor puts themselves above the law. It's simple. If you put yourself above the law, you are violating and neglecting your duty and you are displaying a lack of competence to be able to perform those duties. If you abandon the duties of your oath of office, you no longer have the right to hold that office. The crime in places like San Francisco and Los Angeles is out of control. Police are unable to do their jobs, businesses are closing up shop, and violent criminals are walking free all because of the dereliction of duty by prosecutors who are funded by ideological activists. In Florida, we're not going to sit idly by and watch our state spiral into chaos. We're going to respect our law enforcement officers, we're going to protect our citizens, and we're going to enforce the law. As your Governor, I will not stand for woke prosecutors, who are entrusted with enforcing the law, showing more deference and care for criminals than the victims of their crimes in the name of "social justice." Denying a victim their day in court is not justice. Allowing a criminal to walk free of consequences for their crimes is not justice. It is, in fact, the opposite of justice. [[REJECT WOKE PROSECUTORS]]( "") Florida is a law-and-order state. I am not going to back down from that one inch. The radical Left is already attacking me for doing my job to ensure that the laws are enforced in our state. They are going to use my suspension of a state attorney refusing to do his job to appeal to the members of the woke mob and add to their war chest. Like I've said before, Peter, I will never allow political favor to sway my resolve to do what's right. I need to know that I can count on your support as I prepare to go head-on against the Democrats' crusade against law and order. "" "" "" "" "" Sincerely, Ron DeSantis Paid by Ron DeSantis, Republican, for Governor Ron DeSantis for Governor | 301 W. A few days ago on MSNBC, a so-called political pundit accused Republicans of wanting negroes as candidates so they can puppet them. He went so far as to say Republicans want negroes to do what they're told, and the MSNBC host agreed with him.

I've linked the clip here if you want to watch, but warning it's truly disturbing \---> **[https://secure.winred.com/tim-scott-for-senate/msnbc-racist-attacks](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60987663:6RcUPAVNv:m:1:3331421248:44301CA523BD1540E3A3CAEE0B6A1D54:r "https://secure.winred.com/tim-scott-for-senate/msnbc-racist-attacks")**

_**I am fuming.**_

The Left says they are the party of diversity. They are the party of acceptance. This could not be FURTHER from the truth.

| Hi —

We wanted to give you a legislative update from Washington. Dan is continuing his fight for working families and wants you to hear the latest.

name: Ron DeSantis
subject: Upholding the rule of law and rejecting woke prosecutors.
body:
**[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60989172:JOelzAVNt:m:1:3331421248:3C68545AE07AB28977CF85FEA2156EE3:r)**

Peter,
You've seen across the country a wave of woke prosecutors funded by out of state interests refusing to uphold the rule of law who are allowing criminals to walk free without ever facing consequences for their crimes. As Governor, I have made it clear: **In this state, we uphold the rule of law. We respect the law enforcement officers who put their lives on the line every day to keep our communities safe.**

We DO NOT allow woke activist prosecutors to abdicate their duty to do their job and protect their communities. This is why I took action to right the wrongs of a prosecutor whose conduct has fallen below the standard that is required by the Florida Constitution by refusing to enforce laws he doesn't like. A prosecutor is not a law unto himself.

**_[[UPHOLD THE RULE OF LAW]](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60989172:JOelzAVNt:m:1:3331421248:3C68545AE07AB28977CF85FEA2156EE3:r "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=645171481de93327bc960403d9d6cbc7bf571d819c9300408453fabc7720711dfcdc8d6d712f8c75a5fe90ab67d379481cf2fa49bfdf629a")_**

We are not going to allow this pathogen of ignoring the law that's been going on around the country to get a foothold in the state of Florida. We are going to make sure that our laws are enforced and that no individual prosecutor puts themselves above the law.

It's simple. If you put yourself above the law, you are violating and neglecting your duty and you are displaying a lack of competence to be able to perform those duties. If you abandon the duties of your oath of office, you no longer have the right to hold that office.

The crime in places like San Francisco and Los Angeles is out of control. Police are unable to do their jobs, businesses are closing up shop, and violent criminals are walking free all because of the dereliction of duty by prosecutors who are funded by ideological activists. In Florida, we're not going to sit idly by and watch our state spiral into chaos. We're going to respect our law enforcement officers, we're going to protect our citizens, and we're going to enforce the law.

As your Governor, I will not stand for woke prosecutors, who are entrusted with enforcing the law, showing more deference and care for criminals than the victims of their crimes in the name of "social justice." Denying a victim their day in court is not justice. Allowing a criminal to walk free of consequences for their crimes is not justice. It is, in fact, the opposite of justice.

**_[[REJECT WOKE PROSECUTORS]](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60989172:JOelzAVNt:m:1:3331421248:3C68545AE07AB28977CF85FEA2156EE3:r "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=645171481de93327e26993ba67113f8689f06e8ca94ebda36bd320efd24e432ee79049f01519eca11f1dc046e8b3a44077fbaced8a682f9a")_**

Florida is a law-and-order state. I am not going to back down from that one inch. The radical Left is already attacking me for doing my job to ensure that the laws are enforced in our state. They are going to use my suspension of a state attorney refusing to do his job to appeal to the members of the woke mob and add to their war chest.

Like I've said before, Peter, I will never allow political favor to sway my resolve to do what's right. I need to know that I can count on your support as I prepare to go head-on against the Democrats' crusade against law and order. **_[Are you with me?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60989172:JOelzAVNt:m:1:3331421248:3C68545AE07AB28977CF85FEA2156EE3:r "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=645171481de933275f93e2240482fd3499e8163be20c6fbccf3cfae8ca859ecc3f7e5669955f9d09276a697c2b71a24aa50c2e825ad8b5ba")_**

Sh*t is broken. We’re all mad at each other for the same reasons... The
pandemic sucked. The economy is down. A lot of hardworking families are
financially strapped.

body:
The number 29 seriously tells you everything you need to know about this race.
#
You wanna talk about why our elections are so messed up, Derek? Let’s start with the number 29... because it tells you everything you need to know.
**👉 The average donation to our campaign is $29.**
In order to raise all the money it takes to win this race for you + me + PA, we’ve received a mind boggling 582,000 contributions. Now, you might be thinking: ‘Why the hell would John need 582,000 $29 donations?’ Allow me to explain:
**👉 A big super PAC called “Senate Leadership Fund” (name sounds really nice, huh?) has booked $29 MILLION+ in TV & radio ads to attack me + boost Dr. Oz.**
Derek, this advertising onslaught against us starts in THREE DAYS. And as much as I hate to admit it, we know from experience that when super PACs beat people over the head with these stupid 30-second ads... they can drag you down in the polls.
**So I’m emailing you today for something entirely predictable... $29.** Because we’re behind on our mid-month goal. And, without a whole bunch of you, we aren’t going to be able to push back against this huge negative ad campaign.
[**_So, Derek? Can I get $29 (or more or less, it really doesn’t matter) right now so we can meet our $275k mid-month deadline goal? Seriously, every dollar helps when you’re up against this kind of super PAC spending._**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220812-1?refcode=em20220812-6831&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6831_434096_9J3MwE&akid=6831%2E434096%2E9J3MwE)
**[Contribute $29](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220812-1?refcode=em20220812-6831&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6831_434096_9J3MwE&akid=6831%2E434096%2E9J3MwE)**
It shouldn’t be this way.
You shouldn’t have to be a gazillionaire like Dr. Oz to run for office.
You shouldn’t have super PACs spending $29 MILLION to sink good candidates with ridiculous (and may I add, false) 30-second ads.
But, until we get to the Senate and fight for real campaign finance reform, this is the world we live in. And the only way I know how to beat the Big Money is by energizing as many of YOU as possible to chip in $29 at a time.
**We’ve got 88 days left, and the attacks are going to get worse and worse from here on out.** [**_If you can, please help us reach that $275k mid-month goal so we don’t fall behind + so we can compete toe to toe with the giant super PACs._**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220812-1?refcode=em20220812-6831&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6831_434096_9J3MwE&akid=6831%2E434096%2E9J3MwE)
Me + Gisele + our whole team are so grateful to each and every one of you. It’s because of all our grassroots donors and volunteers and supporters that we have a fighting chance to go up against all that big money and WIN.
John
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20220812-6831-footer&t=1&refcode2=6831_434096_9J3MwE&akid=6831%2E434096%2E9J3MwE)**
---
[](https://www.facebook.com/JohnFettermanPA/) | [](https://twitter.com/johnfetterman) | [](https://www.instagram.com/johnfetterman/)
Email us: info@johnfetterman.com
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way we keep in touch with people like you, so thank you for reading to the end. Small donors like you keep us going. To contribute via check, please address to Fetterman for PA, PO Box 6061, Pittsburgh PA 15211.

Born and raised in rural Davie County, NC, my wife and I have raised our three children and rebuilt a gun store business, while living on the same family farm where I grew up. I am running for Senate to be a part of the movement to Take Back the Senate in November and fight tooth and nail for America First Policies. The situation is dire, and that is why President Trump wholeheartedly endorsed my campaign early on. Our freedoms, liberties, and safety are under attack every day under this administration. Joe Biden’s WOKE agenda is failing our country, and a Far-Left Senate Majority continues to cheer him on. We have a lot of work to do until then, and I am humbly asking for your continued support these next few months. Because this race is not about me, it’s about the future of our nation. Friend,
With a chance to give millions of Americans some of their spending power back, James Lankford instead voted against a $35/month price cap for Insulin costs . More than 1/10th of Oklahomans depend on Insulin to live, and with Insulin costs driving almost 80% of users into debt , this would have been a life changing opportunity for thousands of families. While James Lankford hides in Washington voting against the lives of over 450,000 Oklahomans with diabetes , Madison is reaching out to communities all across the state and gaining an understanding of their challenges.
For someone who values a responsible budget so much, he is reluctant to ease the burden on checkbooks of everyday Americans. Approximately 451,888, or 14.3% of Oklahomans, are living with diabetes, and another 1,036,000 Oklahomans have prediabetes with an increased risk of developing diabetes later in life . Together, more than half of Oklahomans will have to pay billions over the years as a direct result of Lankford’s greed. Americans are paying 10x more for Insulin than any other developed nation , already struggling with out of control medical costs and rising costs. Profits over pulses will be the norm until we elect leaders who will fight for us.
I am running to guarantee affordable prescriptions for all Americans. Will you join in our fight to bring lifesaving, affordable care for all Oklahomans? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/msh]

**Let’s Go Brandon: James Judge wins Greater Brandon Chamber of Commerce straw poll**
_A straw poll conducted Thursday by the Greater Brandon Chamber of Commerce shows James Judge defeating incumbent Democrat Kathy Castor by a wide margin._ TAMPA, Fla. – Republican frontrunner in Florida’s 14th Congressional District primary James Judge on Thursday won a straw poll conducted by the Brandon Chamber of Commerce, not only defeating his primary opponents, but also handily beating Democrat incumbent Kathy Castor.Judge won 83 out of 142 votes, equating to 58.45% of the total vote. Castor placed second with 36 votes (25.35%). The other candidates in the race only garnered single digit percentage points.“Americans nationwide and right here in the Tampa Bay area couldn’t make it clearer: they are done with the disastrous Democrat policies of the past two years that have made them poorer and less safe,” Judge said. “With gas prices hitting all-time highs, food prices soaring, the federal government spending money it doesn’t have and Democrats fomenting civil unrest through movements to ‘defund the police,’ voters are rightfully moving away from the Democratic Party.”Judge is confident in his ability to defeat Castor in the November general election.“We are going to flip this seat from Blue to Red in November,” said Judge. “Florida’s 14th Congressional District is going to be one of a multitude nationwide that rid Democrat incumbents from office in favor of Republicans, and help the Republican Party retake control of Congress. Democrats have shown that they have no business being anywhere near political power, and I expect the voters to treat them as such.”The straw poll is the third Judge has won in the past week, and another positive sign as his campaign continues to gain momentum with less than two weeks before the primary election.

Peter - WE WON!

After all the trials and tribulations, we won the primary and I couldn’t have done it without support from patriots like you!

| | Dear fellow American, Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid. While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law. Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.” By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun. That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.” ** Through** “Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.

Even in a state that voted for Donald Trump, abortion rights were the clear winner. Even as right-wing conservatives ran the ballot measure thinking they could undo abortion rights in Kansas, abortion rights won. And voter turnout was huge.
**We can see the fight for abortion rights is motivating voters, and we must ensure we harness that energy to bring folks out to vote for Democrats in the midterms.**

name: Ron DeSantis
subject: Holding Lawless, Woke Prosecutors Accountable
body:
**[](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c75568%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Y6EFCfzRGw0C7gxbHDQdvA&sysid=1)**

Friend,
You’ve seen across the country a wave of woke prosecutors funded by out of state interests refusing to uphold the rule of law who are allowing criminals to walk free without ever facing consequences for their crimes. As Governor, I have made it clear: **In this state, we uphold the rule of law. We respect the law enforcement officers who put their lives on the line every day to keep our communities safe.**

We DO NOT allow woke activist prosecutors to abdicate their duty to do their job and protect their communities. This is why I took action to right the wrongs of a prosecutor whose conduct has fallen below the standard that is required by the Florida Constitution by refusing to enforce laws he doesn’t like. A prosecutor is not a law unto himself.

**_[[UPHOLD THE RULE OF LAW]](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c75569%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=7FlruvWLeS7qksi9aibBkA&sysid=1 "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=645171481de93327bc960403d9d6cbc7bf571d819c9300408453fabc7720711dfcdc8d6d712f8c75a5fe90ab67d379481cf2fa49bfdf629a")_**

We are not going to allow this pathogen of ignoring the law that's been going on around the country to get a foothold in the state of Florida. We are going to make sure that our laws are enforced and that no individual prosecutor puts themselves above the law.

It’s simple. If you put yourself above the law, you are violating and neglecting your duty and you are displaying a lack of competence to be able to perform those duties. If you abandon the duties of your oath of office, you no longer have the right to hold that office.

The crime in places like San Francisco and Los Angeles is out of control. Police are unable to do their jobs, businesses are closing up shop, and violent criminals are walking free all because of the dereliction of duty by prosecutors who are funded by ideological activists. In Florida, we’re not going to sit idly by and watch our state spiral into chaos. We’re going to respect our law enforcement officers, we’re going to protect our citizens, and we’re going to enforce the law.

As your Governor, I will not stand for woke prosecutors, who are entrusted with enforcing the law, showing more deference and care for criminals than the victims of their crimes in the name of “social justice.” Denying a victim their day in court is not justice. Allowing a criminal to walk free of consequences for their crimes is not justice. It is, in fact, the opposite of justice.

**_[[REJECT WOKE PROSECUTORS]](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c75560%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=KKejXLoZ3OgDGOGZHAB3AQ&sysid=1 "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=645171481de93327e26993ba67113f8689f06e8ca94ebda36bd320efd24e432ee79049f01519eca11f1dc046e8b3a44077fbaced8a682f9a")_**

Florida is a law-and-order state. I am not going to back down from that one inch. The radical Left is already attacking me for doing my job to ensure that the laws are enforced in our state. They are going to use my suspension of a state attorney refusing to do his job to appeal to the members of the woke mob and add to their war chest.

Like I’ve said before, Friend, I will never allow political favor to sway my resolve to do what’s right. I need to know that I can count on your support as I prepare to go head-on against the Democrats’ crusade against law and order. **_[Are you with me?](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c75561%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=XCf%2bc5pdVWlsIY1VKrXRZA&sysid=1 "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=645171481de933275f93e2240482fd3499e8163be20c6fbccf3cfae8ca859ecc3f7e5669955f9d09276a697c2b71a24aa50c2e825ad8b5ba")_**

clean_body: Friend, You’ve seen across the country a wave of woke prosecutors funded by out of state interests refusing to uphold the rule of law who are allowing criminals to walk free without ever facing consequences for their crimes. As Governor, I have made it clear: In this state, we uphold the rule of law. We respect the law enforcement officers who put their lives on the line every day to keep our communities safe. We DO NOT allow woke activist prosecutors to abdicate their duty to do their job and protect their communities. This is why I took action to right the wrongs of a prosecutor whose conduct has fallen below the standard that is required by the Florida Constitution by refusing to enforce laws he doesn’t like. A prosecutor is not a law unto himself. [[UPHOLD THE RULE OF LAW]]( "") We are not going to allow this pathogen of ignoring the law that's been going on around the country to get a foothold in the state of Florida. We are going to make sure that our laws are enforced and that no individual prosecutor puts themselves above the law. It’s simple. If you put yourself above the law, you are violating and neglecting your duty and you are displaying a lack of competence to be able to perform those duties. If you abandon the duties of your oath of office, you no longer have the right to hold that office. The crime in places like San Francisco and Los Angeles is out of control. Police are unable to do their jobs, businesses are closing up shop, and violent criminals are walking free all because of the dereliction of duty by prosecutors who are funded by ideological activists. In Florida, we’re not going to sit idly by and watch our state spiral into chaos. We’re going to respect our law enforcement officers, we’re going to protect our citizens, and we’re going to enforce the law. As your Governor, I will not stand for woke prosecutors, who are entrusted with enforcing the law, showing more deference and care for criminals than the victims of their crimes in the name of “social justice.” Denying a victim their day in court is not justice. Allowing a criminal to walk free of consequences for their crimes is not justice. It is, in fact, the opposite of justice. [[REJECT WOKE PROSECUTORS]]( "") Florida is a law-and-order state. I am not going to back down from that one inch. The radical Left is already attacking me for doing my job to ensure that the laws are enforced in our state. They are going to use my suspension of a state attorney refusing to do his job to appeal to the members of the woke mob and add to their war chest. Like I’ve said before, Friend, I will never allow political favor to sway my resolve to do what’s right. I need to know that I can count on your support as I prepare to go head-on against the Democrats’ crusade against law and order. "" "" "" "" "" Sincerely, Ron DeSantis "RUSH IN A DONATION" Paid by Ron DeSantis, Republican, for Governor Ron DeSantis for Governor | 301 W. body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

After Bernie Sanders’ 2016 presidential campaign, which shook the
political establishment to its core, a few staffers decided to continue
the work to fight to elect progressives by launching Justice Democrats.
For a team with a small budget, we’ve had quite an impact in the last few
years.

We recruited AOC, Cori Bush, and Jamaal Bowman to run and helped their
campaigns win in competitive primary elections against entrenched
incumbents. This cycle we’ve helped Greg Casar and Summer Lee win their
primary elections and now they’re on their way to the General Election in
November.

As a grassroots supported organization, our fundraising makes a big impact
on the level of support that we’re able to offer our endorsed candidates.
Imagine the impact we could have on politics if we had the amount of money
that the DCCC has in the bank.

Right now, we’re a little bit behind on our fundraising compared to last
month and we can’t afford a down month, which is why we’re emailing you
today:

Thank you for being a part of this movement to transform the Democratic
Party from the inside out.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/113345?refcode=em20220812-24690&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=24690%2E1203867%2EpV1gOE ]If you’ve been waiting to make your first contribution to support our
work, this is the best time because your donation will help us reach our
critical mid-month fundraising goal. With less than three months until
Election Day in November, it’s so important that we have the resources to
support our endorsed candidates.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/113345?refcode=em20220812-24690&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=24690%2E1203867%2EpV1gOE ]Contribute

Together we will continue to fight for progress for all of our
communities,

Team JD

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=1023&akid=24690%2E1203867%2EpV1gOE ]here. We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong.

Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=1024&akid=24690%2E1203867%2EpV1gOE ]Centers for Disease Control and your state public health department.

subject: The truth doesn’t matter
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alex Padilla for Senate
body:
All that matters to the GOP is defending Donald Trump no matter what.
#

Did you see this?
[](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-aug22.-sWbty&refcode=em220812-1-30&t=1&akid=938%2E159979%2EA8voAR)
This is Alex’s opponent, and who National Republicans would like to see representing California in the Senate.
Now, let’s be clear here. There’s no double standard. The FBI got a warrant and conducted a legal search, and it’s ridiculous to compare Donald Trump–who incited a violent insurrection to overturn our election– to President Obama or AOC.
Not to mention that neither we nor you nor anyone else knows what is in that warrant until or unless it’s made public.
But for Republicans like Mark Meuser, none of that matters. The truth doesn’t matter. All that matters to the GOP is defending Donald Trump no matter what.
And honestly, it’s a scary sign for our country and our democracy. **California needs a Senator whose loyalties are to what’s best for our democracy and the people of California — not what’s best for Donald Trump.**
So please:
[**Make a $5 donation today to keep Alex in the Senate and help us stop MAGA-Republicans here in California and across the country. California is a big state and expensive to campaign in, so we’re counting on your help to make sure we have what it takes to win.**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-aug22.-sWbty&refcode=em220812-1-30&t=2&akid=938%2E159979%2EA8voAR)
Thank you as always for your support, and for anything you’re able to chip in today.
\- Team Alex Padilla

| People are justifiably angry about the highly politicized raid on Mar-a-Lago. They've seen a pattern with the Department of Justice going all the way back to the Obama Administration.
The Obama Administration's Justice Department used false evidence to obtain a FISA warrant on Donald Trump's presidential campaign in 2016, which led to the bogus Russia investigation, the Mueller report, and other frivolous investigations that went nowhere. And now President Biden's Justice Department just raided Donald Trump's home.
This pattern of malpractice has created immense distrust in the Department of Justice. This institution desperately needs to regain the trust and credibility they've lost. But the raid of Mar-a-Lago does the exact opposite.
People are right to be upset and we need answers. And you can rest assured that we will be conducting serious oversight of the Department of Justice and every other Biden Administration agency when Republicans take back the House of Representatives in November.
You cannot weaponize America's institutions for political gain. The left always claims our democracy is under attack, but they refuse to acknowledge that threatening the sanctity of our institutions and making people lose faith in them is actually a threat to our democracy. And that is exactly what Biden's Justice Department has done.
We need to be able to trust our institutions and it's hard for the American people to do that after what we've seen this week.

| When it comes to electric vehicles, Democrats want all the "stuff" \- but want to stop the things that make the stuff from being made here in America. Let me explain.
The recent Inflation Expansion Act includes a long-standing Republican initiative that prohibits tax credits for electric vehicles unless the battery minerals for such vehicles are at least 40% sourced from North America or a U.S. trading partner starting in 2024, and then 100% of battery components have to be made in North America by 2029 to qualify for tax credits. The credit also won't apply to a vehicle that has any battery components from an entity of concern - i.e. China - by 2024 and no critical minerals from those sources by 2025.
This was necessary because Democrats wanted to pass out tax credits for electric vehicles like candy without any requirement that the material used in these vehicles be made in America.
Here's the problem: not a single EV on the market today would qualify for these credits because Democrats have repeatedly blocked domestic efforts to mine the critical minerals necessary to build EVs.
Biden revoked the long-held lease at the Twin Metals mine in Minnesota, which would have provided copper, nickel, and cobalt. Biden blocked the development of Pebble Mine too, which would have provided copper, and also blocked a titanium mine in Georgia. Moreover, Biden has only approved *20* permits for mines during his whole time in office, with a backlog of 280 projects at BLM, and there are zero reforms included in the Inflation Expansion Act to make the permitting process easier to mine these materials.
This is the same hypocrisy we see from the left on virtually every environmental policy they have become obsessed with.
And let's be clear... this bill Democrats passed will do NOTHING to reduce inflation but will do everything to increase your energy costs, taxes, and the number of IRS agents (87,000!!!) to audit and harass Americans.
This is what you get when Democrats control Congress, which is why Republicans need to take back the House in November.

| This week, Democrats just voted to hire 87,000 *more* IRS agents to harass Americans about their taxes. It was part of the "Inflation Reduction Act"... a ridiculous title for a ridiculous bill that I am proud to vote against.
Guess how many Border Patrol agents we have to secure our southern border? Only 19,536. And guess how many additional Border Patrol agents will be hired to deal with the unprecedented illegal immigration crisis at our border under this Democrat bill? ZERO.
That's right... under the "Inflation Reduction Act" Democrats will make the IRS bigger than the Border Patrol, Pentagon, State Department, and the FBI...COMBINED.
Democrats claim these new agents will crack down on tax fraud from billionaires and large corporations, and that these new agents will help generate the tax revenue to pay for the massive spending in this bill. But billionaires and large corporations employ armies of accountants and lawyers that can fight litigation from the IRS in tax court. Do you have an army of accountants and lawyers to fight the IRS? Of course not. Middle class Americans and small businesses don't have those resources.
It doesn't take a genius to figure out who these 87,000 new IRS agents will target and harass with audits and tax penalties. But then again no one ever accused Chuck Schumer or Nancy Pelosi of being geniuses.
This should tell you all you need to know about the left's priorities. But it's not enough to complain about it.. we actually have to be willing to DO something about it. And the good news is there's a lot we can do.
The first thing we need to do is take back the House of Representatives and take the Speaker's gavel from Nancy Pelosi. And the only way we'll do that is with patriots like you in this fight.
I'm devoting all my energy and resources to take back the House and put our country back on tack.
Are you with me?
