clean_body: | | | | | | | | == | Peter- Dan Crenshaw here. This week, I spoke out against the highly politicized raid of Mar-a-Lago and stressed the need for the Department of Justice to regain the trust of the American people. I also exposed the left's hypocrisy when it comes to electric vehicles and called out Democrats for voting to hire 87,000 new IRS tax agents. As always, thank you for your support. Now, here's your brief: | | | | | | | | MY REACTION TO THE MAR-A-LAGO RAID | | | == | Click to watch on ==, ==, or == | People are justifiably angry about the highly politicized raid on Mar-a-Lago. They've seen a pattern with the Department of Justice going all the way back to the Obama Administration. The Obama Administration's Justice Department used false evidence to obtain a FISA warrant on Donald Trump's presidential campaign in 2016, which led to the bogus Russia investigation, the Mueller report, and other frivolous investigations that went nowhere. And now President Biden's Justice Department just raided Donald Trump's home. This pattern of malpractice has created immense distrust in the Department of Justice. This institution desperately needs to regain the trust and credibility they've lost. But the raid of Mar-a-Lago does the exact opposite. People are right to be upset and we need answers. And you can rest assured that we will be conducting serious oversight of the Department of Justice and every other Biden Administration agency when Republicans take back the House of Representatives in November. You cannot weaponize America's institutions for political gain. The left always claims our democracy is under attack, but they refuse to acknowledge that threatening the sanctity of our institutions and making people lose faith in them is actually a threat to our democracy. And that is exactly what Biden's Justice Department has done. We need to be able to trust our institutions and it's hard for the American people to do that after what we've seen this week. | | | | | | | | THE HEIGHT OF HYPOCRISY | | | == | Watch on == and == | | | When it comes to electric vehicles, Democrats want all the "stuff" \- but want to stop the things that make the stuff from being made here in America. Let me explain. The recent Inflation Expansion Act includes a long-standing Republican initiative that prohibits tax credits for electric vehicles unless the battery minerals for such vehicles are at least 40% sourced from North America or a U.S. trading partner starting in 2024, and then 100% of battery components have to be made in North America by 2029 to qualify for tax credits. The credit also won't apply to a vehicle that has any battery components from an entity of concern - i.e. China - by 2024 and no critical minerals from those sources by 2025. This was necessary because Democrats wanted to pass out tax credits for electric vehicles like candy without any requirement that the material used in these vehicles be made in America. Here's the problem: not a single EV on the market today would qualify for these credits because Democrats have repeatedly blocked domestic efforts to mine the critical minerals necessary to build EVs. Biden revoked the long-held lease at the Twin Metals mine in Minnesota, which would have provided copper, nickel, and cobalt. Biden blocked the development of Pebble Mine too, which would have provided copper, and also blocked a titanium mine in Georgia. Moreover, Biden has only approved 20 permits for mines during his whole time in office, with a backlog of 280 projects at BLM, and there are zero reforms included in the Inflation Expansion Act to make the permitting process easier to mine these materials. This is the same hypocrisy we see from the left on virtually every environmental policy they have become obsessed with. And let's be clear... this bill Democrats passed will do NOTHING to reduce inflation but will do everything to increase your energy costs, taxes, and the number of IRS agents (87,000!!!) to audit and harass Americans. This is what you get when Democrats control Congress, which is why Republicans need to take back the House in November. | | | == | | | | | | | | GET READY FOR THE CRENSHAW YOUTH SUMMIT! | == | The real Wolf of Wall Street, Jordan Belfort. Babylon Bee CEO Seth Dillon. Conservative thought leader Dennis Prager. Legendary entreprenuer Stephen Wynn. What do these people have in common? All of them will be at my 3rd annual Youth Summit in October. That's right, the Crenshaw Youth Summit is back and is right around the corner. Mark your calendars now for October 8 - 9, and we'll see you at the Hilton Americas in Houston, TX. This is the only summit on the planet where you can hear from all of the icons I mentioned above, in addition to a host of interesting and impactful speakers. From North Korean dissidents to leading scientists to thought leaders in the conservative movement, the 2022 Crenshaw Youth Summit has it all. You're not going to want to miss this. This year, we're going to make the youth summit more relaxed. Based on attendee feedback from last year - instead of one long, jam-packed conference day - we're breaking it up into two shorter days. We're adding more meet-and-greets and networking events with speakers to keep this year's summit dynamic and engaging. Visit our == to buy tickets now. | | | == | | | | | | | | "I'M FROM THE IRS AND I'M HERE TO HELP" | | | == | This week, Democrats just voted to hire 87,000 more IRS agents to harass Americans about their taxes. It was part of the "Inflation Reduction Act"... a ridiculous title for a ridiculous bill that I am proud to vote against. Guess how many Border Patrol agents we have to secure our southern border? Only 19,536. And guess how many additional Border Patrol agents will be hired to deal with the unprecedented illegal immigration crisis at our border under this Democrat bill? ZERO. That's right... under the "Inflation Reduction Act" Democrats will make the IRS bigger than the Border Patrol, Pentagon, State Department, and the FBI...COMBINED. Democrats claim these new agents will crack down on tax fraud from billionaires and large corporations, and that these new agents will help generate the tax revenue to pay for the massive spending in this bill. But billionaires and large corporations employ armies of accountants and lawyers that can fight litigation from the IRS in tax court. Do you have an army of accountants and lawyers to fight the IRS? Of course not. Middle class Americans and small businesses don't have those resources. It doesn't take a genius to figure out who these 87,000 new IRS agents will target and harass with audits and tax penalties. But then again no one ever accused Chuck Schumer or Nancy Pelosi of being geniuses. This should tell you all you need to know about the left's priorities. But it's not enough to complain about it.. we actually have to be willing to DO something about it. And the good news is there's a lot we can do. The first thing we need to do is take back the House of Representatives and take the Speaker's gavel from Nancy Pelosi. And the only way we'll do that is with patriots like you in this fight. I'm devoting all my energy and resources to take back the House and put our country back on tack. subject: Caucuses Speak Out
body:
| | | |
---
| | | Patriots,

Despite the hot summer days when most state legislatures are out of session, your state freedom caucuses have been hard at work. Here are some of the highlights:

* After the FBI raided President Trump’s Mar-a-Lago residence, our state freedom caucuses joined the House Freedom Caucus in condemning the action.

* **Nevada Freedom Caucus** Chairman State Rep. Jim Wheeler [stated](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=cb5dddd62b&e=64ecec6d03) “Weaponizing law enforcement for political ends is third-world, banana republic- type stuff. It has become abundantly clear to millions of Americans that the FBI and DOJ choose to apply justice selectively and with hyper-partisan motives. How many more examples must we see? Hillary? Hunter? The list goes on...This, on the heels of Senate Democrats voting to add 87,000 new IRS agents to its ranks, should sound the alarms for Americans of all political stripes.”

* And [this](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=8f4346c3fa&e=64ecec6d03): “The **Arizona Freedom Caucus** is appalled yet sadly unsurprised by the continued use of the U.S. Department of Justice as nothing more than a political weapon targeted at anyone who does not kowtow to the left. First, they weaponized the IRS against conservatives, now they weaponize the DOJ. Joe Biden and Merrick Garland have destroyed nearly any remaining faith that people once had in the FBI and DOJ.”

* In other news, South Dakota Senate President Pro Temp Lee Schoenbeck is an angry establishment leader. When conservatives, including **South Dakota Freedom Caucus** members, received high scores on a Citizens for Liberty legislative scorecard, Schoenbeck wrote [a nasty op-ed](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=c9beaca13e&e=64ecec6d03) criticizing them. He argued that CFL was not a legitimate scorecard (it is) and that the conservative lawmakers were not truly being conservative (they were).

* In response to Schoenbeck’s op-ed, SDFC Chairman Aaron Aylward along with State Rep. Tom Pischke [wrote a piece](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=c495894780&e=64ecec6d03) outlining Schoenbeck’s weak credentials to be judging such scorecards. In short, Schoenbeck is a big fan of Liz Cheney, has voted for multiple tax hikes, supported medical arrests during the pandemic, and defended President Biden’s executive orders.

* It should be noted that Schoenbeck spent money in this year’s primaries trying to defeat two SDFC members – State Reps. Tina Mulally and Tony Randolph. He failed.

* **Schoenbeck is one example of the hundreds of liberals who are masquerading as a “Republican” in the state legislatures. And it’s our state freedom caucuses who are going to expose them.**

* At a big CPAC event in Dallas last week, conservative radio host Glenn Beck [recounted](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=527fdf3fbd&e=64ecec6d03) the awful “RegionSmart” bill that the **Mississippi Freedom Caucus** killed earlier this year.

* You may recall that a woke school district in South Carolina shut parents off from online access to their library. The **South Carolina Freedom Caucus** quickly demanded that they open it back up, which the district promptly did. But now SCFC Vice-Chairman State Rep. R.J. May has submitted a Freedom of Information Act request to the school district demanding more information about the radical ideology the district is promoting in their schools. Stay tuned for more.

* **Illinois Freedom Caucus** member State Rep. Adam Niemerg wrote [an op-ed](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=226db7a3f1&e=64ecec6d03) warning about the National Sex Education Standards being implemented in Illinois schools and is urging parents to fight back. He writes, “the National Sex Education Standards go far beyond biology and seek to teach kids at young ages material that is clearly not age appropriate.”

* **“** The**Nevada Freedom Caucus** Will Safeguard The 2A From The Feds” was the headline of [a recent op-ed](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=9a501286ad&e=64ecec6d03) by NVFC Vice Chair State Rep. Jill Dickman and our state director, Daniel Honchariw. Key excerpt: “Assemblywoman Dickman’s proposal — supported by the full weight of the Nevada Freedom Caucus — would provide Nevadans the ability to forge our own path on preserving the Second Amendment, ensuring our great state remains a place where citizens know our rights are protected regardless of what political shenanigans take place in D.C.”

Please consider donating [$10](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=85f0ee09fb&e=64ecec6d03), [$25](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=aaffcc7bb4&e=64ecec6d03), or [$50](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=de6c7b554b&e=64ecec6d03) so our state freedom caucuses can continue to fight for you and your family.
Regards,

Andy Roth
President, State Freedom Caucus Network

| | Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York _magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a “Great Reset” of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ —Hillsdale College’s digest of liberty—author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as “‘capitalism with Chinese characteristics’—a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below.” Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for—and opposition to—socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c552c2fedaf3413c8564ccb227c2b05e&_e=Ymp07SHGi6hylSivpOFVY6mWxtg8zFuN1IuCVOOgIHSNLYn5OT8Ri4jZ880m8H7W1XYDqMPDwBsaavl11Rva9GOCtuoYXJr_cRd-Y6sBYtZg9i3TS4K-GzhK7io5utP8u5wvPNsZfZKZiMuIcRDCIoPXmn9e2hrmVcg_55f9RkFhLovw31xiJVRAnRDYjKBSkMVmxr0_5FWodDex0RsYIf34UrjPGm18xFd0L_a5EBTaXRu6KJ1tEHgYBU5wPWnNnp_ABipwcIb9c69Cka-Kr8D_ibbdFe4vaLTcsBnd1n_Nf3uK1ojX6zekeAKkU_GhZ-pnVmlpZXpShK1sWaF4T5OLx2r-AvBMwyDZ4DbXPivUCZsQ1NsgDSwMnDyJovSNCcXakSVMEzaQuPbzeyrIa00U8fjs_EmJD7uDX2Ou0IdrYlSTjHx0WdnJWV0nn7NPOQ4na4JAJg_ZNovpJRQPz3-dagXpZgxmUcn2VoJuObA%3D)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages. ** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left’s “long march through the institutions”—including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory—which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race—are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale’s work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That’s why I need your thoughts quickly. ** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism **in the next five days**, **your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, “Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy.” If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c552c2fedaf3413c8564ccb227c2b05e&_e=Ymp07SHGi6hylSivpOFVY6mWxtg8zFuN1IuCVOOgIHSNLYn5OT8Ri4jZ880m8H7W1XYDqMPDwBsaavl11Rva9GOCtuoYXJr_cRd-Y6sBYtZg9i3TS4K-GzhK7io5utP8u5wvPNsZfZKZiMuIcRDCIoPXmn9e2hrmVcg_55f9RkFhLovw31xiJVRAnRDYjKBSkMVmxr0_5FWodDex0RsYIf34UrjPGm18xFd0L_a5EBTaXRu6KJ1tEHgYBU5wPWnNPdUNAvvG23thZm8IzWZ0LOjk3JJiuh1EgUdJvvTA-dSfGPzcrd-iz0iUKRFXig3-hGju1ZQxMKZeapZdKIA0BaM-u4rh9revy0f4ShO20D_JHEQXrx3wjCjGkDZt14oB-umIdpeupeV-3zaZqOmOc9vviaU9iER3JJIc_R9oF6NyE3yDsv0gTJbngWREZ13n3TJ3u2fod9AK0WnxAh_iyWeX6lPaL97UWSQnPMlsrbM%3D)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember—**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Friend,

God has blessed America. But our freedom will only survive if we protect it, if we take our duty and our obligation seriously.

But I also know that at this moment, we are confronting a domestic threat that we have never faced before. And that is a former president who is attempting to unravel the foundations of our Constitutional Republic. And he is aided by Republican leaders and elected officials who have made themselves willing hostages to this dangerous and irrational man.

Now, some in my party are embracing former President Trump. And even after all we’ve seen, they’re enabling his lies. Many others are urging that we not confront Donald Trump, that we look away. **_And that is certainly the easier path._**

But to argue that the threat posed by Donald Trump can be ignored is to cast aside the responsibility that every citizen – every one of us – bears to perpetuate the Republic. We must not do that, and we cannot do that.

During this time of testing, I am asking for your help. **James Judge, Republican Party win Tampa Bay Chamber straw poll for Florida’s 14th Congressional District**
_Judge remains the Republican favorite in Florida’s 14th Congressional District primary by winning the straw poll among Republicans, and the total number of Republican votes was higher than that of Democrats._ TAMPA, Fla. – The Republican frontrunner in Florida’s 14th Congressional District, James Judge, won a straw poll conducted by the Tampa Bay Chamber of Commerce on Wednesday by a decisive margin.Judge won 72 out of 123 votes (58.53%) of the Republican votes. Two other Republican candidates, including one whose votes may not even count on election day, split the rest of the vote among the party.Furthermore, the straw poll was conducted among Republicans, Democrats and Independents, and showed that overall, Republicans garnered more support than Democrats. Only 109 respondents chose a Democrat – incumbent Kathy Castor or her primary challenger Christopher Bradley – while 123 total votes were cast for the Republican candidates. That means Republicans received 53% of the vote, and Democrats only 47%.Judge was grateful for the support and applauded the outcome.“Kathy Castor is nervous, and she absolutely should be,” Judge said. “She’s ramped up her campaign efforts for the first time in years, because she knows that she and her Democrat colleagues in Congress have earned their future removal from office, which is coming this November.”“I’m not surprised by this poll result at all,” said Judge. “Americans are rightfully fed up with sky-high inflation, rising costs of fuel and food, massive debt and other Democrat policies that Kathy Castor and her friends have supported. They have made life undeniably more difficult for Americans over the past two years, and when the votes are counted in November, I think they’ll come out in our favor.”The straw poll is another positive sign for Judge, as his campaign continues to gain momentum with less than two weeks remaining before the primary election.Judge recently earned the recommendation of the Tampa Bay Times, and has been endorsed by legendary Republican strategist Roger Stone, Congressman Paul Gosar (R-AZ), retired Republican Congressman Ted Yoho, Pinellas County Sheriff Bob Gualtieri, The Tampa Police Benevolent Association, Clearwater Mayor Frank Hibbard, the Community Patriots Tampa, Chris Chambers, a former Congressional candidate and community leader, and former SBA White House Deputy Chief Matt Becker, who previously ran for Congress against an incumbent Democrat in St. Petersburg.**About James Judge:
** Judge, who publicly announced his run for Congress earlier this year, is the only Tampa Bay area native running in the race, having been born in Clearwater, Florida. Judge graduated from Eckerd College in St. Petersburg and served in the U.S. Coast Guard in Operation Iraqi Freedom. Additionally, he served in Kabul, Afghanistan as a spokesman for the U.S. Department of Defense from 2010 until 2011. He now owns Judge Public Relations, a Tampa-based PR firm and marketing agency with clients worldwide.Judge is married to his wife Danielle, who is also a small business owner in Hillsborough County. The Judges are avid animal lovers and together, they have four dogs, three cats, two horses and 10 chickens. Judge is a proud member of the NRA, Coastal Conservation Association, Veterans of Foreign Wars and the American Legion. The Judges are also active members at Idlewild Baptist Church in Tampa.

body:
| | |
---
Peter, my mom is a lot busier than usual these days. I'm sure it's no surprise to anyone, but running for U.S. Senate is no walk in the park.
But even though my mom is working long hours and traveling all across our state, she still makes time to ask me how I'm doing and check in on her grandchildren, who she adores. That's the kind of mom she is, the kind of person she is, and the kind of senator she will be.** **
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49153515/361020654/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk224-fr-nd-v1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZjFjYjQ1ZC04MDFhLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AUyFs7fYmS9U5ctj4rlcHCtj2006DANHjO6m1aNI9Hs=)
**My mom has always been my fiercest advocate, my loudest cheerleader, and my strongest defender. **Regardless of what she was juggling, my mom has been there for me – for all my highs and all my lows.
She was there when I became a Saint Louis University alumna and a nurse just like her.
She was there to style my veil on my wedding day and give a heartfelt, tender speech that can still bring a tear to my eye when I remember it.
And she was also there to bandage every injury, to hug me during every heartbreak, and to hold my hand when I faced some of the scariest, most uncertain moments of my life.
When my dad died and, decades later, when we lost my oldest brother, too, my mom led my entire family through unimaginable grief with understanding, openness, and resolve.
**My mom is the type of leader who will be there no matter what – the kind our great state deserves.**
I have seen countless other politicians swoop in for photo ops, handshakes, and parades but then flee when their constituents had to grapple with senseless gun violence, natural disasters, rising costs of living, and corrupt insurance companies. But not my mom.

clean_body: | | | Peter, my mom is a lot busier than usual these days. I'm sure it's no surprise to anyone, but running for U.S. Senate is no walk in the park. But even though my mom is working long hours and traveling all across our state, she still makes time to ask me how I'm doing and check in on her grandchildren, who she adores. That's the kind of mom she is, the kind of person she is, and the kind of senator she will be. = My mom has always been my fiercest advocate, my loudest cheerleader, and my strongest defender. Regardless of what she was juggling, my mom has been there for me – for all my highs and all my lows. She was there when I became a Saint Louis University alumna and a nurse just like her. She was there to style my veil on my wedding day and give a heartfelt, tender speech that can still bring a tear to my eye when I remember it. And she was also there to bandage every injury, to hug me during every heartbreak, and to hold my hand when I faced some of the scariest, most uncertain moments of my life. When my dad died and, decades later, when we lost my oldest brother, too, my mom led my entire family through unimaginable grief with understanding, openness, and resolve. My mom is the type of leader who will be there no matter what – the kind our great state deserves. I have seen countless other politicians swoop in for photo ops, handshakes, and parades but then flee when their constituents had to grapple with senseless gun violence, natural disasters, rising costs of living, and corrupt insurance companies. But not my mom. Democrat Nikki Budzinski is running for Congress in Illinois' 13th District. This district is currently in Republican hands, and is by far one of the most competitive in the entire country.

Nikki has spent her life fighting for workers and working families by strengthening unions nationwide, and she was instrumental in passing a $15 minimum wage in Illinois while working as a senior advisor for Governor JB Pritzker. subject: They hurled paint bombs at my house
body:
| | | Dear Fellow American, As a leader in the pro-life movement, I’m urgently reaching out to folks like you who believe in life, liberty, and the rule of law to join me in a special mission. [**Will you help me hold accountable members of the radical anarchist pro-abortion group “Reproductive Justice Union” for their attacks on my family and other pro-life advocates?** ](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e2aca2c012e842d989880a50741bf42c&_e=hz3IE-MQ8Wgkk2s0YWU7Y6WeQfEZ5gnRZwi_Pj607LhBWPTIKG_tPtj6IGgYpucQiT_YXK1AFF03kuolSePqKXjvVUryOd_4QPd2SQHikEMKuLK-jjp8YmL_TUxUNPxhfvmDwT3bI8bzd9uWz87rLqsEiYCDI68NWmUIP8UFOzsGulKwQyvRTblyLcEIuqv7U9GJkAysl5TcNMTpLS5gRlU-FmeZKz8t6QYRp6-fPAo6sz53wVx6p6H25GRgrQFqxXoAmcdVgGstFkLc6Ke6hFLKnIeXRpafD4pdPnPNe3tfIxvid0SAWWAWQ554FD5_J4g0jKqkiv6z5FC7WlIVXS8c_83zJdFAV27eiNhsh4U-RwE1ED9rX0muk0t54JxSjfbGXv4ekdF4nj-_BX3LqgkgB0XLjVnxb8d8PFQU1S0%3D) Please, allow me to explain... My name is Tom Brejcha and I’m the president and founder of the Thomas More Society, a non-profit law firm dedicated to defending life, family, religious liberty, and election integrity. Perhaps you recognize my name from our work representing David Daleiden in his high-profile court battles with Planned Parenthood, the National Abortion Federation, and the state of California. In the days following the Supreme Court’s decision to overturn _Roe v. Wade,_ “Reproductive Justice Union” made credible threats against me on Twitter. They “doxed” me, distributing flyers revealing my home address with my face front and center, highlighting all the things I’ve done to defend the right to life for preborn babies and our other shared values throughout my career.

---
[](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e2aca2c012e842d989880a50741bf42c&_e=hz3IE-MQ8Wgkk2s0YWU7Y6WeQfEZ5gnRZwi_Pj607LhBWPTIKG_tPtj6IGgYpucQiT_YXK1AFF03kuolSePqKXjvVUryOd_4QPd2SQHikEMKuLK-jjp8YmL_TUxUNPxhfvmDwT3bI8bzd9uWz87rLqsEiYCDI68NWmUIP8UFOzsGulKwQyvRTblyLcEIuqv7U9GJkAysl5TcNMTpLS5gRsFYEqbro-vxtE8M5FSm8TZsa7yTh-cq2hr12Ya0wP0yTcutG9FOUnD0Q0BUordi4KqwGTsQkpb92L-Msg330DjibBZr0a6kE82gLwF0Fxsmtxm6Rcd50E5MgD5apUzILHeZroU3-qcz-UmI0D1M1QQJxW6_bcpe6sw3EMBdNC_asJd3dJZhXJuKZk3s-zwzNeUxWteRlbkSYOSDIZG4C0U%3D)
---
And finally, on July 1st, they attacked our home. As police looked on, 40-50 thugs from “Reproductive Justice Union” gathered in front of my home screaming obscenities about me, the pro-life movement, and the Supreme Court. _**They tore up an American flag, shouting “Death to America,” and uprooted my wife’s beloved rose bush.**_ Then suddenly they launched loud smoke bombs, surged onto the lawn, and hurled paint bombs at our home. Fortunately, my wife and I were not home. We are safe and sound. But our property is not. The beautiful brick house — the home where my wife Debbie and I raised our two sons — is stained with indelible green paint. Worse, the “F” word, anarchist symbols (circled capital “A”), and ugly slogans like “No God, No Rulers” and “Abort the Supreme Court” cover our driveway and sidewalk. We've hired a series of experts to remove and/or paint over this graffiti, but some of it still won't come off. [**That’s why I’m asking you to make a tax-deductible donation of $35, $50, $100 or more to help the Thomas More Society hold these****criminals accountable — all while we******](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e2aca2c012e842d989880a50741bf42c&_e=hz3IE-MQ8Wgkk2s0YWU7Y6WeQfEZ5gnRZwi_Pj607LhBWPTIKG_tPtj6IGgYpucQiT_YXK1AFF03kuolSePqKXjvVUryOd_4QPd2SQHikEMKuLK-jjp8YmL_TUxUNPxhfvmDwT3bI8bzd9uWz87rLqsEiYCDI68NWmUIP8UFOzsGulKwQyvRTblyLcEIuqv7U9GJkAysl5TcNMTpLS5gRkQOU8CrJFnB7SVQvX-0qVcsJxL7T6pnQwJ7Te6ybfbYAbprzoUmJlXKXg3D2FWmpRsHI9YoR41qF4tPGRHPHTUGXXzOH7lr8sKa8BsX1Z7flEICNXLxT8v6w9e46gyoOZALirSCuPef9hJt1A2XWwAhnD-WE5HNUTVubGF0RRJ7cyP3b_0T1iP2kBl8h-B6K1Q_p4KD5456INlldqsvNZE%3D)[**continue defending life in court battles across the country**](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e2aca2c012e842d989880a50741bf42c&_e=hz3IE-MQ8Wgkk2s0YWU7Y6WeQfEZ5gnRZwi_Pj607LhBWPTIKG_tPtj6IGgYpucQiT_YXK1AFF03kuolSePqKXjvVUryOd_4QPd2SQHikEMKuLK-jjp8YmL_TUxUNPxhfvmDwT3bI8bzd9uWz87rLqsEiYCDI68NWmUIP8UFOzsGulKwQyvRTblyLcEIuqv7U9GJkAysl5TcNMTpLS5gRoFVIY8pRh7_jsAPiPgVQwGbRSIpUCX2m6BO6NGpoQ911pUUTrW1G64ZCPW1PUjS91SkqGRr7Jk9t2-83TNlk857sZPMXUJCUspoQ-4qUwpBQzSNgSbPVnfaTCc-pO-gcC2zY6P_JSkMBtzE5kw98zwIrzhfkmCWqKVW4y63laEyRHfzUpzxHqtu2bmyc5d7aC2H_aMrkZTQDMmQG5v4M84%3D)**.** You see, thanks to the Twitter threats against us earlier that week, we had just beefed up our home security system with new cameras. We also hired detectives who photographed the pro-abortionists' cars and license numbers. So, we may be able to identify and track down several suspects, one or more of whom drove up to our north suburban Chicago home from Missouri. Yet not one person has been held accountable. That’s right. As of now, no criminal charges have been filed. Sadly, I’m not the only target of radical pro-abortion activists in the aftermath of the _Dobbs_ decision. Pregnancy centers and churches alike have suffered vandalism and even arson at the hands of groups like “Reproductive Justice Union,” “Jane’s Revenge,” and other anarchist groups. **But these thugs cannot intimidate the Thomas More Society.** If the district attorneys don’t bring charges against the criminals responsible for the damage at my home and others, then we are prepared to file civil lawsuits! My friend, we must put a stop to these attacks, identify all of the perpetrators, and hold them accountable — so please do not delay. [**Please follow this link to donate $35, $50, $100 or more today.** ](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e2aca2c012e842d989880a50741bf42c&_e=hz3IE-MQ8Wgkk2s0YWU7Y6WeQfEZ5gnRZwi_Pj607LhBWPTIKG_tPtj6IGgYpucQiT_YXK1AFF03kuolSePqKXjvVUryOd_4QPd2SQHikEMKuLK-jjp8YmL_TUxUNPxhfvmDwT3bI8bzd9uWz87rLqsEiYCDI68NWmUIP8UFOzsGulKwQyvRTblyLcEIuqv7U9GJkAysl5TcNMTpLS5gRn_OhyRU7WJha9RCPZ8axoLY17I3mQ5D2_S5IUadT2X3pLH8_tDM7Dj-BnXelChnxouWD6IWJVzqVe7Pc1EdNpmEXucaxJN6phsfr1rPO5S9I-OUIBX5GtiwDTQgna4MNftvXT_pRPhVf84Av8pCaSZQF_aZ8k7GL3rRCaKfNltHmZnKO5W1kF1piS1dINvZZNtz1gzl4WLY0Fqf8D0ZjUA%3D) Mark my words: This is not the end of the violence we’ll see from the radical abortion lobby. In fact, I expect it will only escalate. We must be prepared to fight back and show “Reproductive Justice Union” and all seeking to intimate and harm us that we will not take their attacks sitting down. [**So, I pray you’ll find it in your heart to help the Thomas More Society fight back by making a tax-deductible donation or $35, $50, $100 or more.** ](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e2aca2c012e842d989880a50741bf42c&_e=hz3IE-MQ8Wgkk2s0YWU7Y6WeQfEZ5gnRZwi_Pj607LhBWPTIKG_tPtj6IGgYpucQiT_YXK1AFF03kuolSePqKXjvVUryOd_4QPd2SQHikEMKuLK-jjp8YmL_TUxUNPxhfvmDwT3bI8bzd9uWz87rLqsEiYCDI68NWmUIP8UFOzsGulKwQyvRTblyLcEIuqv7U9GJkAysl5TcNMTpLS5gRkeML7WW6bfXxnZSdNMng-kl7w46KgTwZjEWp8zY3viq4MVfSDjpu2ESbEjVnwHN2qcA6rtHJ9CLK-LDuGXnb6rkTkNYEJbNy3mf7kMdGCRZzQcnEGzxCo4AzWAebQVuF9_bYsnbKQjdcx3823DRZ7F6ephMe2LENomSrCXUckVaDe7F2K1zUwYFQtY9gebeRUBB73n1bqQZRtz4hFxD_Wk%3D) Thank you for standing with me to defend life and the rule of law. May God bless you,
---
[](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e2aca2c012e842d989880a50741bf42c&_e=hz3IE-MQ8Wgkk2s0YWU7Y6WeQfEZ5gnRZwi_Pj607LhBWPTIKG_tPtj6IGgYpucQiT_YXK1AFF03kuolSePqKXjvVUryOd_4QPd2SQHikEMKuLK-jjp8YmL_TUxUNPxhfvmDwT3bI8bzd9uWz87rLqsEiYCDI68NWmUIP8UFOzsGulKwQyvRTblyLcEIuqv7U9GJkAysl5TcNMTpLS5gRpYiqCdlCS19Gq6nuHU39zSqkPKyN0OwWxyzWLd2ugdim0BBmQWIPxKi75vP2Dm8NmfDfEY_N1FwHZg9SsKWstK0fdo3lFzu8Jm4JRFbX2zOa3sjgkto2W9pWkif0gdjZze0hzcy2VSseh416S8iSZfhi_1CgCOaaZM1vIJJCpx5pWpvNwPMttjrltETRWLxvqBJ4f52e3Q6q39JSM7ckS0%3D)
---
Tom Brejcha
President & Chief Counsel
---

clean_body: | | | Dear Fellow American, As a leader in the pro-life movement, I’m urgently reaching out to folks like you who believe in life, liberty, and the rule of law to join me in a special mission. Please, allow me to explain... My name is Tom Brejcha and I’m the president and founder of the Thomas More Society, a non-profit law firm dedicated to defending life, family, religious liberty, and election integrity. Perhaps you recognize my name from our work representing David Daleiden in his high-profile court battles with Planned Parenthood, the National Abortion Federation, and the state of California. In the days following the Supreme Court’s decision to overturn Roe v. Wade, “Reproductive Justice Union” made credible threats against me on Twitter. They “doxed” me, distributing flyers revealing my home address with my face front and center, highlighting all the things I’ve done to defend the right to life for preborn babies and our other shared values throughout my career. And finally, on July 1st, they attacked our home. As police looked on, 40-50 thugs from “Reproductive Justice Union” gathered in front of my home screaming obscenities about me, the pro-life movement, and the Supreme Court. They tore up an American flag, shouting “Death to America,” and uprooted my wife’s beloved rose bush. Then suddenly they launched loud smoke bombs, surged onto the lawn, and hurled paint bombs at our home. Fortunately, my wife and I were not home. We are safe and sound. But our property is not. The beautiful brick house — the home where my wife Debbie and I raised our two sons — is stained with indelible green paint. Worse, the “F” word, anarchist symbols (circled capital “A”), and ugly slogans like “No God, No Rulers” and “Abort the Supreme Court” cover our driveway and sidewalk. We've hired a series of experts to remove and/or paint over this graffiti, but some of it still won't come off. . You see, thanks to the Twitter threats against us earlier that week, we had just beefed up our home security system with new cameras. We also hired detectives who photographed the pro-abortionists' cars and license numbers. So, we may be able to identify and track down several suspects, one or more of whom drove up to our north suburban Chicago home from Missouri. Yet not one person has been held accountable. That’s right. As of now, no criminal charges have been filed. Sadly, I’m not the only target of radical pro-abortion activists in the aftermath of the Dobbs decision. Pregnancy centers and churches alike have suffered vandalism and even arson at the hands of groups like “Reproductive Justice Union,” “Jane’s Revenge,” and other anarchist groups. But these thugs cannot intimidate the Thomas More Society. If the district attorneys don’t bring charges against the criminals responsible for the damage at my home and others, then we are prepared to file civil lawsuits! My friend, we must put a stop to these attacks, identify all of the perpetrators, and hold them accountable — so please do not delay. Mark my words: This is not the end of the violence we’ll see from the radical abortion lobby. In fact, I expect it will only escalate. We must be prepared to fight back and show “Reproductive Justice Union” and all seeking to intimate and harm us that we will not take their attacks sitting down. Thank you for standing with me to defend life and the rule of law. May God bless you, Tom Brejcha President & Chief Counsel P.S. Now that Roe v. | | | | | Peter, NPR has strange priorities. **By now I’m sure you’ve seen the viral video of Beto O'Rourke responding to a Greg-Abbott supporting heckler as he talked about the somber reality of our children murdered by assault rifles. NPR saw it, and they were outraged ... by Beto swearing.** **_[THANK BETO for saying what must be said, and doing what must be done. Please join us in giving $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to Beto O'Rourke. Because we can't afford 2023 where he is not Governor of Texas.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T047f0be9-5731-4356-9cef-a850385f21e4/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)_** **_If you're exhausted by Democrats too often refusing to hit back, comment or message aggressively against Republicans who lie, cheat, steal, coup, take away our rights and pocket our taxes, it's a reminder of why we need the next generation of fighters in the Democratic Party to take over, and oh my, is Beto O'Rourke one of those._** Beto was speaking about assault rifles, and how they were weapons made for the battlefield--which every sane human including the creator of the assault rifle has acknowledged--the damage they do to little bodies in schools as they were made to pierce helmets of opposing soldiers. In fetid, disrespectful, and honestly abominable right-wing fashion, as he was talking about children being murdered by assault rifles, he was heckled by a Greg Abbott supporter in the crowd who started laughing.** ** **_Laughing at kids dying via assault rifle. Think about that._** **Then Beto responded the way we all wish we had, not like some polished politician but a real human with real emotions:** **_" It may be funny to you motherf***er but it's not funny to me."_**

body:
**Friend, we have a Republican ticket.** We are excited to unite the party under last night’s primary election winners:
* Ron Johnson for U.S. Senate
* Tim Michels for Governor
* Roger Roth for Lieutenant Governor
* Eric Toney for Attorney General
* John Leiber for State Treasurer
* Amy Loudenbeck for Secretary of State

[](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYo--3UqFRYFg8Lsn0cgAtTvheTZIBulG9nsDqgd8dcDVi6n3_Bu6kmhic3vepu8oSrCzf2AGmg6CIgZpIcHpYm8&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=paul_post_primary_v1&n=1) Unlike the Democrats, who didn’t trust their primary voters and pressured their candidates to fall in line, we are grateful that Republicans were able to make their own informed choices thanks to our candidates’ willingness to step up to the plate and bring their unique perspectives to the table. **Now, the real work begins.** [****](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYo--3UqFRYFg8Lsn0cgAtTvheTZIBulG9nsDqgd8dcDVi6n3_Bu6kmhic3vepu8oSrCzf2AGmg6CIgZpIcHpYm8&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=paul_post_primary_v1&n=2) Friend, I don’t have to tell you everything that’s on the line. You know that this election is about fighting back against the failed Democrat agenda that has caused prices to soar, crime to spike, and our kids’ education to crumble. **It’s critical that we re-elect Ron Johnson, send Tim Michels to the Governor’s Office, and succeed in races across the state.** [**Would you be willing to donate just $20.22 to help us elect Republicans up and down the ballot?**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYo--3UqFRYFg8Lsn0cgAtTvheTZIBulG9nsDqgd8dcDVi6n3_Bu6kmhic3vepu8oSp9GZq26X1JRkif8yhJWrCw&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=paul_post_primary_v1&n=3) Our field teams have already made over 1 million voter contacts across the state, and we’re opening offices to bring our message to communities across Wisconsin. But as coastal liberals from New York and California pour money into our state, we need to make sure we can continue these efforts and compete to win.**** [**Elections are a game of inches in Wisconsin. Your donation could be what makes the difference. Can you help?**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYo--3UqFRYFg8Lsn0cgAtTvheTZIBulG9nsDqgd8dcDVi6n3_Bu6kmhic3vepu8oSrCzf2AGmg6CIgZpIcHpYm8&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=paul_post_primary_v1&n=4) Sincerely, Paul Farrow

Hello,
Well, it didn’t take long. **Less than an hour after I was declared the Democratic nominee for Senate in Iowa, the attacks from Chuck Grassley began.**
_“The most liberal nominee in Iowa Senate history”
“Radical”
“Socialist”_
Gotta love it!
Chuck Grassley doesn’t know what to say about me. He’s never faced an opponent like me before. I’m his political nightmare, so he’s just throwing cow pies at the wall and hoping something sticks.
Calling me “radical” is laughable when Chuck Grassley supports a complete ban on abortion and letting literally anyone buy an AR-15 without even a background check. **But there’s one attack that I absolutely won’t take lying down, and that’s Chuck Grassley’s attacking me for serving our country for 36 years in the U.S. Navy.**

clean_body: Raphael Warnock’s runoff win last year is the reason why Democrats control the Senate today. | Fellow American, My goal is to beat Senator Raphael Warnock on November 8 with a majority of the vote. But with recent polls showing nobody is currently winning more than 50% of the vote, we must also be prepared for the possibility that the Senate race could go to a runoff election in December - even if it's something we're hoping to avoid. In Georgia, if no candidate wins more than 50% of the vote on November 8, we have a runoff or ... overtime. Overtime is something I'm familiar with from my days playing football. I can tell you this about overtime:it's not something I enjoyed then, and it's not something I want to experience now. This race is incredibly close, Fellow American. If you help us now with a donation, we'll invest it wisely and do our best to win outright on November 8 without a runoff. Don't forget - Raphael Warnock's runoff win last year is the reason why Democrats control the Senate today. We can't let that happen again this year, but we're running out of daylight between now and Election Day. We've got to get our ads on the air at full strength and get our grassroots army mobilized, but these things take money we don't have yet. With nearly 90% of his fundraising haul coming from outside Georgia, Senator Warnock has the resources to win this race outright. We don't. subject: We just made legislative history
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JOSH GOTTHEIMER FOR CONGRESS
body:
---
| | Team,

Today, we passed the Inflation Reduction Act, ensuring that this country is ready to lower prescription drug prices, boost domestic manufacturing, tackle the climate crisis, cut the deficit, and so much more – this is a major step in the right direction.

The bill represents the largest climate investment in US history, tackles the high cost of prescription drugs, lowers the national deficit by roughly $305 billion through 2031 — all without raising any taxes on individuals, families, and small businesses in my District. That was critical to me.

subject: We kept our promise:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Andy Kim for Congress
body:
The House just passed the Inflation Reduction Act, and now the bill is heading to President Biden's desk for his signature.

This bill is a game-changer on so many levels.

I came to Congress in 2019 on the promise to fight for working families, lower health costs and protect those with pre-existing conditions. Today, we deliver on that promise.

Here's what it does:

➡️ Caps out-of-pocket prescription drug costs to $2,000 per year or $166 per month. So many seniors struggle to pay for the high cost of medication. This will cap that cost so they don't have to choose which medications they can afford. I have fought for and co-wrote this provision, and I'm thrilled to see it become the law.

➡️ Empowers Medicare to negotiate drug prices. Big Pharma fought hard to keep this from passing – that tells you all you need to know. We are finally giving Medicare the negotiating power they need to bring down the costs of drugs for Medicare recipients.

➡️ Caps insulin costs at $35/month for seniors on Medicare. I voted to cap insulin at $35/month for every American, but Senate Republicans stripped it from the bill. This will be a huge help for those on Medicare, and I will keep fighting for a cap on insulin costs for ALL Americans.

The Inflation Reduction Act is also the most significant investment in addressing the climate crisis in our nation's history, boosting clean energy production, reducing greenhouse gas emissions by 40% over the next decade, and creating millions of good-paying jobs here in America. It will help lower costs today, while shifting to cleaner sources of American energy in the future.

Finally, it provides real tax reform to ensure ultra-wealthy corporations pay their fair share — and makes a big dent in reducing the deficit and easing inflation.

This bill delivers some much-needed relief and progress for New Jersey families. More work is needed, but this bill is a great step forward.

Andy

Change begins at the local level and we can never forget that. It was wonderful to see so many people turn out and vote yesterday. Words can't begin to express how proud I am of Team Roe. Your support and belief in this campaign are why we are here now. This team worked hard to organize and turn out voters. I owe an immense thanks to all the volunteers, grassroots supporters, elected officials, my staff, and most especially the people of WI-01 who made this happen. This enormous victory would not have been possible without the tireless drive of everyone who makes up this wonderful community in our district. Thank you. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: ****=** | **=** ---|--- **=** | **=** **=** | **=** Thank you for showing up. Now let's do this. – Ann Roe = ** **=

I wanted to send a quick thank you note for helping to push my good friend Brad over the finish line in Tuesday’s primary. I always had faith that he’d pull it off, but we can never take a single vote for granted. So now that it’s official, from the bottom of my heart: THANK YOU!
Because of the generosity and commitment of supporters like you, Democrats of Wisconsin’s Third District have nominated a hardworking, courageous, and compassionate nominee to replace me in Congress. Brad has the leadership and fortitude to tackle the challenges our state and our country are facing at this critical time. I couldn’t be more thrilled to see him advance to the general election.
_But now, the real fight begins_.

They’ll vote to make all abortions against the law if they got the chance. It’s time to vote for pro-choice leaders and put an end to the Indiana GOP’s grip on the state._
**\- How the American Rescue Plan is Delivering for the Hoosier State - ** [Statewide:](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49148101/360995675/-1668094455?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NDdiZGY3Mi02OTFhLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DQZx1PwgNNKyrp-hR63cz-cVep0jQextw39MqVbjN0A=&emci=08ea04f5-641a-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=447bdf72-691a-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=4925535) Indiana used ARP dollars to create the Indiana Homeowner Assistance Fund, and since its launch in March, this program has provided about 900 recipients the opportunity to catch up on bills like mortgage payments, insurance costs, and property taxes. [Northeast Indiana:](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49148102/360995676/-1596320365?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NDdiZGY3Mi02OTFhLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DQZx1PwgNNKyrp-hR63cz-cVep0jQextw39MqVbjN0A=&emci=08ea04f5-641a-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=447bdf72-691a-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=4925535) Thanks to the state’s READI program - [which is fully-funded by the Rescue Plan](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49148103/360995677/-1612065418?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NDdiZGY3Mi02OTFhLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DQZx1PwgNNKyrp-hR63cz-cVep0jQextw39MqVbjN0A=&emci=08ea04f5-641a-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=447bdf72-691a-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=4925535) \- Fort Wayne’s airport will see updates to its Gateway West terminal, housing and apartment developments will be built in Wabash and Huntington, and a new manufacturing training lab will be available in Kendalville. [Boone County](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49148104/360995678/1440506704?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NDdiZGY3Mi02OTFhLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DQZx1PwgNNKyrp-hR63cz-cVep0jQextw39MqVbjN0A=&emci=08ea04f5-641a-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=447bdf72-691a-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=4925535): about $2 million will be used to expand broadband internet throughout the county. This is a part of the overall $250 million investment the Rescue Plan is delivering for the Hoosier State.

You've seen across the country a wave of woke prosecutors funded by out of state interests refusing to uphold the rule of law who are allowing criminals to walk free without ever facing consequences for their crimes. As Governor, I have made it clear: **In this state, we uphold the rule of law. We respect the law enforcement officers who put their lives on the line every day to keep our communities safe.**

We DO NOT allow woke activist prosecutors to abdicate their duty to do their job and protect their communities. This is why I took action to right the wrongs of a prosecutor whose conduct has fallen below the standard that is required by the Florida Constitution by refusing to enforce laws he doesn't like. A prosecutor is not a law unto himself.

**_[[UPHOLD THE RULE OF LAW]](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60989397:6h6PSAVN4:m:1:3334294963:94CE5CFFCFC114C0D8751605D030EDB7:r "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=645171481de93327bc960403d9d6cbc7bf571d819c9300408453fabc7720711dfcdc8d6d712f8c75a5fe90ab67d379481cf2fa49bfdf629a")_**

We are not going to allow this pathogen of ignoring the law that's been going on around the country to get a foothold in the state of Florida. We are going to make sure that our laws are enforced and that no individual prosecutor puts themselves above the law.

It's simple. If you put yourself above the law, you are violating and neglecting your duty and you are displaying a lack of competence to be able to perform those duties. If you abandon the duties of your oath of office, you no longer have the right to hold that office.

The crime in places like San Francisco and Los Angeles is out of control. Police are unable to do their jobs, businesses are closing up shop, and violent criminals are walking free all because of the dereliction of duty by prosecutors who are funded by ideological activists. In Florida, we're not going to sit idly by and watch our state spiral into chaos. We're going to respect our law enforcement officers, we're going to protect our citizens, and we're going to enforce the law.

As your Governor, I will not stand for woke prosecutors, who are entrusted with enforcing the law, showing more deference and care for criminals than the victims of their crimes in the name of "social justice." Denying a victim their day in court is not justice. Allowing a criminal to walk free of consequences for their crimes is not justice. It is, in fact, the opposite of justice.

**_[[REJECT WOKE PROSECUTORS]](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60989397:6h6PSAVN4:m:1:3334294963:94CE5CFFCFC114C0D8751605D030EDB7:r "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=645171481de93327e26993ba67113f8689f06e8ca94ebda36bd320efd24e432ee79049f01519eca11f1dc046e8b3a44077fbaced8a682f9a")_**

Florida is a law-and-order state. I am not going to back down from that one inch. The radical Left is already attacking me for doing my job to ensure that the laws are enforced in our state. They are going to use my suspension of a state attorney refusing to do his job to appeal to the members of the woke mob and add to their war chest.

Like I've said before, Peter, I will never allow political favor to sway my resolve to do what's right. I need to know that I can count on your support as I prepare to go head-on against the Democrats' crusade against law and order. **_[Are you with me?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60989397:6h6PSAVN4:m:1:3334294963:94CE5CFFCFC114C0D8751605D030EDB7:r "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=645171481de933275f93e2240482fd3499e8163be20c6fbccf3cfae8ca859ecc3f7e5669955f9d09276a697c2b71a24aa50c2e825ad8b5ba")_**

This historic bill will cut costs for hardworking Americans.
Peter,

It's no secret that inflation has made it harder for people to make ends meet. Folks are feeling the squeeze of rising costs across the globe and in America.

**But ****Peter**** - I have some good news!** Congress has come together to send the Inflation Reduction Act to President Biden's desk for a signature.

This legislation will lower the cost of life-saving prescription drugs, reinvest in domestic manufacturing, reduce health care costs for millions of Americans, and shrink the deficit. On top of that, this legislation will lower energy costs and create thousands of new jobs in the green energy sector. It's the largest investment in climate resilience and environmental justice in America's history!

One of my top priorities for the folks across our state has always been to reduce costs so everyone can get ahead. **I proudly supported this inflation-cutting proposal in the House to deliver results, not just for Washington State, but for everyone who has been feeling the squeeze of rising costs.**

**[This victory was made possible because folks like you voted, volunteered, and supported Democrats up and down the ticket. This is YOUR victory. Derek

Hi team,

The contrast could not be more stark.

Today, **our House majority sent the once-in-a-generation Inflation Reduction Act to President Biden for his signature.** Just as the pundits were declaring us dead and done, we delivered on our biggest promises: lowering the cost of health insurance and prescription drugs, restoring America’s leadership in clean energy, all while making corporations like Amazon pay taxes, and _reducing the deficit_ to tamp down inflation.

Meanwhile, the Republicans took to the airwaves, not to propose their own plans for fighting inflation or for bringing jobs back to America, but to compare American law enforcement to the Nazi Gestapo, to demand that we defund the FBI, and to call the United States a “banana republic,” simply because we remain a country where no one is above the law

A few weeks ago, I knocked on the door of a retired firefighter. He was not a Democrat. But when I asked him what his biggest challenge was, he told me it was the $4,000 a year he is paying for just one of the prescription drugs he needs. **The Inflation Reduction Act will cap his total out-of-pocket bill for drugs at $2,000. Democrats delivered that. Tom Kean Jr. and the Republicans were dead set against it.**

In the last few weeks, we also delivered the CHIPS and Science Act, to spur high tech manufacturing and innovation in America, the PACT Act, to help veterans suffering from toxic exposure, and the first gun violence prevention law in decades. We followed America’s biggest ever investment in infrastructure with our biggest ever commitment to fight climate change.

These breakthroughs are happening for one reason: Because engaged, concerned citizens like you voted, organized, and worked tirelessly to elect our Democratic majority in the first place. So thank you for the role YOU played to get us here today.

Our next job is to PROTECT this progress. If the extremist GOP comes to power in November, they’ve promised two years of chaos and culture wars – a national abortion ban, endless impeachments, promotion of the Big Lie. They’ve now purged from the House virtually every moderate Republican who stood up to Trump, while embracing Tom Kean Jr., who promised to have Trump’s back “no matter what Trump does.”

Ours is one of THE most competitive House districts in the country. If we hold this seat, we can defend our entire House majority and keep making the progress we saw today.

If you’d like to unsubscribe, | | Hi team, The contrast could not be more stark. Today, our House majority sent the once-in-a-generation Inflation Reduction Act to President Biden for his signature. Just as the pundits were declaring us dead and done, we delivered on our biggest promises: lowering the cost of health insurance and prescription drugs, restoring America’s leadership in clean energy, all while making corporations like Amazon pay taxes, and reducing the deficit to tamp down inflation. Meanwhile, the Republicans took to the airwaves, not to propose their own plans for fighting inflation or for bringing jobs back to America, but to compare American law enforcement to the Nazi Gestapo, to demand that we defund the FBI, and to call the United States a “banana republic,” simply because we remain a country where no one is above the law A few weeks ago, I knocked on the door of a retired firefighter. He was not a Democrat. But when I asked him what his biggest challenge was, he told me it was the $4,000 a year he is paying for just one of the prescription drugs he needs. The Inflation Reduction Act will cap his total out-of-pocket bill for drugs at $2,000. Democrats delivered that. Tom Kean Jr. and the Republicans were dead set against it. In the last few weeks, we also delivered the CHIPS and Science Act, to spur high tech manufacturing and innovation in America, the PACT Act, to help veterans suffering from toxic exposure, and the first gun violence prevention law in decades. We followed America’s biggest ever investment in infrastructure with our biggest ever commitment to fight climate change. These breakthroughs are happening for one reason: Because engaged, concerned citizens like you voted, organized, and worked tirelessly to elect our Democratic majority in the first place. So thank you for the role YOU played to get us here today. Our next job is to PROTECT this progress. If the extremist GOP comes to power in November, they’ve promised two years of chaos and culture wars – a national abortion ban, endless impeachments, promotion of the Big Lie. They’ve now purged from the House virtually every moderate Republican who stood up to Trump, while embracing Tom Kean Jr., who promised to have Trump’s back “no matter what Trump does.” Ours is one of THE most competitive House districts in the country. subject: How's this for Contrast?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Max Steiner for Congress 2485 Notre Dame Blvd, Ste 370 #194 Chico, CA 95928
body:
It's a good week to be a Democrat. | |
---
Friend, **This has been a very good week to be a Democrat and a very bad week to be a Republican.** In the face of Republican opposition, Democrats passed the Inflation/Health Care/Climate Act, which will devote $370 billion to address climate change over the next ten years. It's the biggest climate bill we've passed in U.S. History -- not to mention the landmark health and inflation components it includes. Yes, I wish it could have been stronger -- and it was disheartening to see ex-Green Party member Kyrsten Sinema fight to keep taxes low on the top 0.1%. That's a reminder that we need to build on our majority in November. **Contrast that with the anti-American, anti-Rule of Law craziness that is the modern GOP.** Seeing Republican politicians line up to condemn the FBI raid on Trump's Mar-a-Lago residence shows that the GOP is more interested in protecting their own than finding out the truth. They don't care when "their team" breaks the law, because the law isn't important to them. They just want power, and they'll break the law if that helps them steal it. I think moderate voters in CD-1 are starting to notice that the Republican Party is unhealthily focused on defending Trump from the legal consequences of his many illegal actions. Doug LaMalfa is firmly in camp "do whatever Trump says." Democrats, on the other hand, are delivering: gas prices are down, we're passing good laws, and unemployment is still dropping. It's a good week to be a Democrat. Sure, it's fine to take some cheer from Trump's legal troubles, but let's celebrate our WINS. And let's get some more wins in November, starting right here in CD-1. **[This Sunday marks the middle of the current fundraising quarter, and we're aiming to reach 50% of our quarterly fundraising goal before then to keep our pace going strong. clean_body: It's a good week to be a Democrat. | | Friend, This has been a very good week to be a Democrat and a very bad week to be a Republican. In the face of Republican opposition, Democrats passed the Inflation/Health Care/Climate Act, which will devote $370 billion to address climate change over the next ten years. It's the biggest climate bill we've passed in U.S. History -- not to mention the landmark health and inflation components it includes. Yes, I wish it could have been stronger -- and it was disheartening to see ex-Green Party member Kyrsten Sinema fight to keep taxes low on the top 0.1%. That's a reminder that we need to build on our majority in November. Contrast that with the anti-American, anti-Rule of Law craziness that is the modern GOP. Seeing Republican politicians line up to condemn the FBI raid on Trump's Mar-a-Lago residence shows that the GOP is more interested in protecting their own than finding out the truth. They don't care when "their team" breaks the law, because the law isn't important to them. They just want power, and they'll break the law if that helps them steal it. I think moderate voters in CD-1 are starting to notice that the Republican Party is unhealthily focused on defending Trump from the legal consequences of his many illegal actions. Doug LaMalfa is firmly in camp "do whatever Trump says." Democrats, on the other hand, are delivering: gas prices are down, we're passing good laws, and unemployment is still dropping. It's a good week to be a Democrat. Sure, it's fine to take some cheer from Trump's legal troubles, but let's celebrate our WINS. There’s no sitting on the sidelines and hoping our enemies leave us alone.**We have no option. We must fight back. **

The Church Committee was created in the 1970’s and chaired by Democratic Sen. Frank Church of Idaho. The committee investigated abuses by American intelligence agencies like the CIA, NSA, and FBI in both the domestic and foreign spheres.

McCarthy must take up this crusade and have Congress hold the FBI and the rest of the Deep State accountable by setting up a similar committee.

I stand by [what I said on Twitter](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=b6c252dde3&e=17913c7d6d), the FBI has become weaponized against the American people.**It’s time to stop pretending we can reform the FBI.**

Friend,
You’ve seen across the country a wave of woke prosecutors funded by out of state interests refusing to uphold the rule of law who are allowing criminals to walk free without ever facing consequences for their crimes. As Governor, I have made it clear: **In this state, we uphold the rule of law. We respect the law enforcement officers who put their lives on the line every day to keep our communities safe.**

We DO NOT allow woke activist prosecutors to abdicate their duty to do their job and protect their communities. This is why I took action to right the wrongs of a prosecutor whose conduct has fallen below the standard that is required by the Florida Constitution by refusing to enforce laws he doesn’t like. A prosecutor is not a law unto himself.

**_[[UPHOLD THE RULE OF LAW]](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6656181a3a7c486ab9c5b4d310e8d690&_e=FoK46Tjl49vB9iHDAW9buYBDSltLnkAO6ExW3MNq8h2HkmIJtgDqN-doYPfeoB8qcbDXKwWApEICPu7QQuHHIeJgcHM6XVddtsoyRk0b8dn9mihUHdRIACYiLIdjPOwVLemS6IwDx9V998gvt0vSpSy2x-yDHieQX_yc34cwwW4TKyJZsZB-aSKTgfb_Opzkwi9UTNgDwPLIL3G7irii_8xIHFkoO86wMVpIF4potFjqLfoBgpVqnC8z12fhIxEzhMl4cIZLNziS4S4cyGgoEIn1OnsddA7vFY-qV7OTacYznOR-P9pL5NOCMNq4DDvkW-1q6SCC82KY8yYy7s49wA%3D%3D)_**

We are not going to allow this pathogen of ignoring the law that's been going on around the country to get a foothold in the state of Florida. We are going to make sure that our laws are enforced and that no individual prosecutor puts themselves above the law.

It’s simple. If you put yourself above the law, you are violating and neglecting your duty and you are displaying a lack of competence to be able to perform those duties. If you abandon the duties of your oath of office, you no longer have the right to hold that office.

The crime in places like San Francisco and Los Angeles is out of control. Police are unable to do their jobs, businesses are closing up shop, and violent criminals are walking free all because of the dereliction of duty by prosecutors who are funded by ideological activists. In Florida, we’re not going to sit idly by and watch our state spiral into chaos. We’re going to respect our law enforcement officers, we’re going to protect our citizens, and we’re going to enforce the law.

As your Governor, I will not stand for woke prosecutors, who are entrusted with enforcing the law, showing more deference and care for criminals than the victims of their crimes in the name of “social justice.” Denying a victim their day in court is not justice. Allowing a criminal to walk free of consequences for their crimes is not justice. It is, in fact, the opposite of justice.

**_[[REJECT WOKE PROSECUTORS]](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6656181a3a7c486ab9c5b4d310e8d690&_e=FoK46Tjl49vB9iHDAW9buYBDSltLnkAO6ExW3MNq8h2HkmIJtgDqN-doYPfeoB8qcbDXKwWApEICPu7QQuHHIeJgcHM6XVddtsoyRk0b8dkMrnF5-vDSeSCgqruSQMiD9UYK5VM7wGWX1eMozw_RkbFZlc0ydhrFPTCQN2_Xu8_7msC0f1n5nUXHMTGOtG9zxzx8S0CrcEyz6L8tTT2dEpKyROiM03nxme1OYmxyM5Ti_H-vpuf2in1r2js7A8xkXwVfOuxlXi6gylds6fzjYirW4uXbehieryTovHOaTJIlYuKyMaMsxLld-shw44YWtDKKl279VdwPzPDYa1XGVA%3D%3D)_**

Florida is a law-and-order state. I am not going to back down from that one inch. The radical Left is already attacking me for doing my job to ensure that the laws are enforced in our state. They are going to use my suspension of a state attorney refusing to do his job to appeal to the members of the woke mob and add to their war chest.

Like I’ve said before, Friend, I will never allow political favor to sway my resolve to do what’s right. | | Peter,

Last week, Arizonans turned out to vote in the primary for the midterm elections, nominating candidates up and down the ballot.

We now know _exactly_ what we’re up against this November, so we want to break down some of the important races in Arizona and exactly why they’re crucial to protecting our rights and democracy.

[**_But first, will you quickly make a donation to help us register and turn out Democratic voters before November?_**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/49159334/361042175/-413476556?amount=24&refcode=20220812_E_F_US_NA_NA_8E_T3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNVkwvMS83ODUyMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NGJiNTFhYy05MjFhLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EkN9EbsaKIlKZZJmPyWdXfzEiWoOVhRZRhM9ZlGGQ70=) | **_The Arizona midterms breakdown_**

**_Governor_** Democrat Katie Hobbs is facing Republican Kari Lake, **a die-hard Trump loyalist who is a leading voice behind 2020 election fraud claims**. Republicans are desperate to keep the governorship in GOP hands, **recently pouring $11,000,000 into commercials aiming to beat Democrats and elect Lake!** **_Senate_** Senator Mark Kelly is facing reelection against Trump’s hand-picked candidate, Blake Masters, **who has been hailed by Tucker Carlson as the "GOP’s future"**. Masters is a far-right extremist with close, direct ties to anti-democracy theorist Peter Thiel. **_House_** In the recent primary, voters nominated a whopping _SEVEN_ U.S. House candidates **who claim Trump won in 2020 and have spread lies about the election**.
---
Folks, if these Republicans win their races in November, it would mean absolute disaster for the future of our reproductive freedoms, LGTBQ+ rights, and our democracy.

That’s why we’re laser-focused on registering and mobilizing young Latinx voters who overwhelmingly vote Democrat. We know these newly registered voters could make a monumental difference in November’s election, and that’s because our work made all the difference in electing President Biden and flipping the House and Senate blue in 2020.

But folks, we won’t be able to do this critical work without resources, and we’re going to need support if we want to make a _huge_ difference in Arizona this November.

body:
Dear friends,
Today, Congress passed the Inflation Reduction Act, a historic piece of legislation that has put climate change front and center by funding $369 billion in domestic energy production and manufacturing, reducing carbon emissions by roughly 40% by 2030. Communities like ours need this funding for critical programs in energy security and climate change. [https://larchmontloop.com/mamaroneck-flood-victims-hopeful-senate-bill-passes-house/]
This bill will lower the energy costs for every American including lowering prices at the pump and helping people like us afford new technologies that will lower emissions and energy prices. That includes:
*
$9
billion
in
consumer
home
energy
rebate
programs
*
Up
to
$7,500
tax
credits
when
purchasing
electric
vehicles
*
$1
billion
grant
program
to
make
affordable
housing
more
energy
efficient
*
$6
billion
invested
into
disadvantaged
communities
that
increases
grant
funding
to
rehabilitate
homes
and
mitigate
negative
impacts
of
a
declining
transit
network,
to
name
a
few
When elected to Congress I will continue to represent your best interests and act as your voice to create and drive new legislation that further lessens the burden on every day New Yorkers. This bill is a historic start but we have far more work to do on improving flood mitigation; funding our local infrastructure; addressing gun violence by instituting universal background checks, national red flag laws, banning ghost guns, and raising the age for gun ownership; protecting women’s reproductive rights and access to an abortion; securing our safety by supporting Israel and our international democratic allies; and fighting to reinstate and increase the SALT tax deduction to end the inequitable taxation of New York residents.
You can count on my promise that the interests of my constituents will ALWAYS come first, and not, as we’ve witnessed with our current representative, when it suits a personal agenda. I have always worked for the betterment of all residents in my district, and when in Congress, you can be assured I will fight for you and your children’s future.
Starting tomorrow, Saturday, August 13, you can vote for that better future. See below for more voting information.

My name is Bailee, and I am working with the campaign to organize and mobilize our field of supporters and volunteers across MO. Over the coming weeks and months, I hope to have more opportunities and ways to engage with you and our fellow Independents across the state, and I appreciate your patience and continued support as we get things off the ground.

Please don't hesitate to get in contact with me for questions, concerns, or feedback in general. I look forward to working with you to make sure we bring home that 'W' in November!

---
Fellow American,

My goal is to beat Senator Raphael Warnock on November 8 with a majority of the vote.

But with recent polls showing nobody is currently winning more than 50% of the vote, we must also be prepared for the possibility that the Senate race could go to a _**runoff election in December**_ - even if it's something we're hoping to avoid.

In Georgia, if no candidate wins more than 50% of the vote on November 8, we have a runoff or ... _**overtime**_.

**Overtime is something I'm familiar with from my days playing football. I can tell you this about overtime:_it's not something I enjoyed then, and it's not something I want to experience now._**

name: Laura Nevitt,  Keystone Progress
subject: Netroots Nation needs volunteers!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Keystone Progress Education Fund, www
body:
Dear Friend,

As you may know, the largest gathering of progressive activists in the country is coming to Pittsburgh next weekend. And they need volunteers — can you help?

Netroots Nation, from August 18-20th, will offer over 150 sessions including panels, trainings, deep-dive professional development sessions, art and film screenings, and more. Whether you're passionate about labor issues, women's rights, disinformation, voting rights, climate change, or all of the above and more, Netroots has a ton to offer.

Netroots is looking for a few more great volunteers for their conference. The health and wellness of the community is of the utmost importance, and all participants will be required to be vaccinated and have at least one booster, as well as masking while folks are inside. Volunteer tasks and times vary -- from helping with registration to exhibit hall support to general event support. It's a great way to connect with folks across the community, and registrations are significantly discounted for volunteers. The more shifts you can take on the more you'll save -- 60% or more off. Netroots is also very teen friendly-- many folks have made volunteering at Netroots a family affair!

Sign up here. [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1WTJPGyW6GB1HoBS26PVrVZqXvA9rdkIZ6O5s6R37Dag/viewform?edit_requested=true]

And Netroots' volunteer manager, Will, will get back to you. If you have specific questions, reach out to volunteers@netrootsnation.org. They have an active and helpful volunteer Facebook group too!
If you want to help but might need to carpool or share a room somewhere, there's an NN FB group Netroots can connect you with, and you can also post on their event page.

Laura Nevitt
Executive Director
Keystone Progress

The day he became President in 2017, the Left started coming after him with impeachment lies. They slandered him. They belittled him. They came after all of us day after day, and it's all for one reason: THE LEFT IS AFRAID OF HIM. This is not who we are, Friend. This is banana republic antics. Having Mar-a-Lago, the home of the 45th President of the United States , raided by FBI agents is unprecedented. This is not who we are as a democracy. clean_body: Friend — This week, we're celebrating a special anniversary. It's been five years since I joined JB as his running mate. There was no rulebook for how we could best navigate the unprecedented times we experienced, yet we overcame. It's one of the great honors of my life to serve as your Lt. Governor. Now, if JB and I have your support in this race, will you please volunteer with our team? Even when battling a once-in-a-century pandemic, JB and I never forgot about our promises to working families. We enshrined the right to choose into state law before the Supreme Court could overturn Roe v. Wade. We expanded access to affordable health care and eliminated the Medicaid backlog. We raised the minimum wage to $15 per hour and defended workers' rights. And we established the largest infrastructure program in state history to modernize roads, bridges, ports, and railways. We've worked too hard to get Illinois back on track to allow the GOP to drag us off course. This is about more than an election. This is about everything we believe in. If you share JB's and my vision for moving Illinois forward, I hope you'll take this step to help make it a reality: Let's keep fighting the good fight, Juliana Paid for by JB for Governor Email sent to: dpwillis67@gmail.com * JB for Governor P.O. Peter,

We now have **less than 90 days until the midterms** , and Biden and the Democrats are getting more aggressive every day.

They’re **not holding back** on forcing their radical agenda through Congress.
They’re **increasing** federal spending and worsening inflation.
They’re **growing** the size and power of the federal government.
They’re **beating us** in fundraising AND in the polls for the Senate majority.

I don’t what else to say, Peter - [**If we’re going to take back the Senate, WE must get more aggressive with our fundraising, especially at the grassroots level.**](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=5d271fd2b42843b0b3607eed4771b045&_e=70zj_VWYtdsVngt_6HOxWj1nnHhe9xwUi1dAsomZrJlz0qaxBPuHhGnZ7ynOD-JV4NKxwnOyrJFD4IfXoDTKnF0lGsMfbXauJFhOLIa6XS7dWmcH4HT411_sqoZuEyt9cCwqkxX0PmUfQCibsksfJCZy2J8RKE4iT6YenkowoIgtd_VclabBp6W9-2-72gQcy0L9KAlv_cTouqVuafT9AWOv1BlqjWaVP6V8QFkMUfzZZcb-CdQPDzzjU3fIgO2bqaBj6u2n5Y0gUWkfkOs4URkiHgy6pmvhEDeF1UGpRaPtOzm9bgsgRQd2H0XACHD6vepv-mNEU0M37EEL3t8NF4WF87jiVw3a28R_hgCsW1KHi5OYzNrQ45h-F5tAF5UX3U0EdcjcxFKSHLqQJoP80stj1ZbAb4jSX7iJvXy6JRnAu5qEPr4t3KBY4BVFONc_)
