##
12 August 22

This Tuesday, will make one month since the Primary election and the ballots are still being counted! We need a better system and better people in office.

There are 6 weeks until mail-in ballots are sent out (Sep 24) and 10 weeks until early voting begins (Oct 27-Nov 3). We have a lot of work to do! We need your help to get America back on course.

For the first time in 35 years we have an opportunity to make a REAL difference. Please seize THIS moment!

Phase II, leading to the General election, has several components:
1) Local media and social media presence
2) Volunteer recruitment
3) Fundraising
4) Signage throughout the District
5) Pre-recorded voicemail team
6) Texting voters
7) Sign Waving
8) Prayer

Here are some questions to consider:
Who do you know that has Press contacts, Press experience or social media experience?
Who can help with sign installation?
How many hours per week can you give to leave Jeff Warner's pre-recorded message with voters?
Who can you help enlist to be part of this amazing team?
Can you give at least one hour per week to campaign for the residents of MD4?

Jeff has continued to interact with voters while sign waving at major intersections throughout the District. The response in these strong democratic areas is very positive. It appears that the worse the economy becomes, the more powerful Jeff Warner's message of hope and restoration resonates with voters. Something special is happening!

In addition, every Beltway exit in the District from New Hampshire Ave. to Pennsylvania Ave. (except two) have large Jeff Warner For Congress signs in each direction. Signs are also on the inner and outer loops of the Beltway, Rt. 50 (East & West bound) and the BW Parkway (North & South bound). Let's pray this help increase Jeff Warner's name recognition.

**Sign Waving**
This Saturday, August 13
Noon-1p
The intersection of Pennsylvania Ave (Rt 4) & Forestville Rd.
Park in the Industrial Bank Parking Lot
7610 Pennsylvania Ave., Forestville, 20747
FREE JW4C Tshirt provided for those who have not yet received one.

We are asking you for your donations and we are asking for your service. Together, we can do this! This is the power of teamwork! And the Best Is Yet To Come! Please reach out to us at info@JeffWarnerForCongress.com

In 12 weeks, the General Election counting will be in process. Let's Get This Done! Together!

[**Donate Here**](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e2b757c427e67a891eab3e1b8&id=ccc0e77020&e=12a37459a2)

Remember, Jeff Warner is standing with you and for you. Enough is Enough! Together, "We The People" can make a real difference. Now is our time to act. THERE IS HOPE!

Standing with you,

Jeff

body:
[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Derek,

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1619?refcode=sa_em_220812_B2_SYARhodesScholar_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1005&akid=1431%2E1862389%2EzDS8K7 ]In a moment, I will ask you to donate to our campaign to create a
Georgia where opportunity is available to everyone — regardless of their
background. But first, I want to tell you a story about why it is so
important to create a state where everyone can thrive:

In November 1994, I vied for a prize no one like me had ever won before —
one I had no road map for winning — the Rhodes Scholarship.

Prior to my junior year of college, I feared applying for this prestigious
award, which I thought was only given to the true heirs of American power
— not a working-class Black woman from Mississippi like me. I was afraid
that outside the comfort of my bubble, I would prove all those who had
looked down on me correct.

When I voiced these fears to my mother, she told me, “We never imagined,
from where we began, we would have a daughter who would have this
opportunity. You can’t fail, even if you don’t win. Because you’ve already
won the hardest part.”

A few weeks later, I learned I did not win the Rhodes Scholarship. The
loss devastated me, but in the attempt, I changed my life. This gave me
the courage to go on to Yale Law School, run for political office and
become the Minority Leader of the Georgia House of Representatives.
Because suddenly, I saw opportunity where I had never been brave enough to
look before — and where no one who looked like me had been.

I’m running for governor to open the doors of opportunity for people all
across our state, to give Geogians the chance to explore their own
potential and to create a Georgia where everyone can thrive — regardless
of their background or zip code.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1619?refcode=sa_em_220812_B2_SYARhodesScholar_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1006&akid=1431%2E1862389%2EzDS8K7 ]But I need your help to get there. Derek,
can you please chip in to my campaign
right now, to seize this moment and build a state where everyone has the
opportunity to thrive?

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1619?refcode=sa_em_220812_B2_SYARhodesScholar_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1007&akid=1431%2E1862389%2EzDS8K7 ]DONATE

Stacey Abrams

body:
We need a Senate that fights for progress

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=793%2E61531%2ElPhNEY)
It’s a big day—today Peter Welch will cast his vote in the House for the largest climate investment in our nation’s history. (And it never would’ve happened with a Republican Senate.)
The Inflation Reduction Act will transform America by lowering costs for working families, forcing big corporations to pay their fair share, and making the largest climate investment in history. This bill will help us cut U.S. emissions by 40% by 2030 and be pivotal to the just energy transition we know our economy needs.
This bill wouldn’t have been possible without winning Senate seats in Georgia and giving Democrats a narrow majority. It's an important reminder of how much is at stake in this race. We must elect Peter, or risk losing the Senate to Mitch McConnell and with it any chance of progress next year.
[**Please, chip in today and keep Vermont’s critical seat blue. Your contribution will help send Peter Welch, a champion for climate policy, to the Senate.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3825?t=3&akid=793%2E61531%2ElPhNEY)

Hello,
I just got an email I had to read twice before I could even believe it was real.
A so-called “reporter” from Fox News just reached out for comment, because apparently Chuck Grassley and the Republicans are pushing a story about Mike Franken’s special needs daughter.
The story isn’t about how Mike and his wife fostered her. It’s not about how they decided to adopt her. It’s not even about how Mike missed her first steps because he was serving our country in uniform. Nope...
**It’s a hit piece. Fox “News” and Chuck Grassley are actually ATTACKING Mike for having a special needs daughter.** I’m sorry, but I don’t care if you call yourself a reporter or not. That’s not an email that I will ever dignify with a response.

As Governor, I have made it clear: **In this state, we uphold the rule of law. We respect the law enforcement officers who put their lives on the line every day to keep our communities safe.**

We DO NOT allow woke activist prosecutors to abdicate their duty to do their job and protect their communities. clean_body: In this state, we uphold the rule of law. We respect the law enforcement officers who put their lives on the line every day to keep our communities sa| | | Peter, You’ve seen across the country a wave of woke prosecutors funded by out of state interests refusing to uphold the rule of law who are allowing criminals to walk free without ever facing consequences for their crimes. As Governor, I have made it clear: In this state, we uphold the rule of law. We respect the law enforcement officers who put their lives on the line every day to keep our communities safe. We DO NOT allow woke activist prosecutors to abdicate their duty to do their job and protect their communities. This is why I took action to right the wrongs of a prosecutor whose conduct has fallen below the standard that is required by the Florida Constitution by refusing to enforce laws he doesn’t like. A prosecutor is not a law unto himself [[UPHOLD THE RULE OF LAW]]( "") We are not going to allow this pathogen of ignoring the law that's been going on around the country to get a foothold in the state of Florida. We are going to make sure that our laws are enforced and that no individual prosecutor puts themselves above the law. It’s simple. If you put yourself above the law, you are violating and neglecting your duty and you are displaying a lack of competence to be able to perform those duties. If you abandon the duties of your oath of office, you no longer have the right to hold that office. The crime in places like San Francisco and Los Angeles is out of control. Police are unable to do their jobs, businesses are closing up shop, and violent criminals are walking free all because of the dereliction of duty by prosecutors who are funded by ideological activists. In Florida, we’re not going to sit idly by and watch our state spiral into chaos. We’re going to respect our law enforcement officers, we’re going to protect our citizens, and we’re going to enforce the law. As your Governor, I will not stand for woke prosecutors, who are entrusted with enforcing the law, showing more deference and care for criminals than the victims of their crimes in the name of “social justice.” Denying a victim their day in court is not justice. Allowing a criminal to walk free of consequences for their crimes is not justice. It is, in fact, the opposite of justice [[REJECT WOKE PROSECUTORS]]( "") Florida is a law-and-order state. I am not going to back down from that one inch. The radical Left is already attacking me for doing my job to ensure that the laws are enforced in our state. They are going to use my suspension of a state attorney refusing to do his job to appeal to the members of the woke mob and add to their war chest. Like I’ve said before, , I will never allow political favor to sway my resolve to do what’s right. I need to know that I can count on your support as I prepare to go head-on against the Democrats’ crusade against law and order. Black moms deserve to see their children grow up too. |
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49154225/361023333/2058529741?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTcwOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNDVlYmRjNC04MTFhLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=e7RxTEWvRpHf5GS-nJz3dW7oUxWqCjLNajob9gR0DXg=&emci=617b9f8d-7b1a-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=145ebdc4-811a-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=5086640)

Peter, as a physician, I have seen this firsthand: Black moms are 3-4 times more likely to die in childbirth than white moms and more likely to suffer complications.

Racial gaps in income, housing, access to insurance, and education can all play a role, but bias within healthcare settings can affect Black birthing people across income and education levels. Symptoms may be ignored, tests and procedures skipped, and hospitals serving Black communities can be deeply underfunded.

After witnessing the disparities in labor and delivery rooms, I stepped up to become a part of Governor Wolf's Maternal Mortality Review Committee to combat this issue affecting so many. I made Black maternal health a top priority in my campaign, and now, I'm asking Congress to do the same. **[Will you join me in demanding action to save the lives of Black moms? Tell Congress to invest in reducing Black maternal mortality now.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49154226/361023334/-1463453417?ms=em22_220812_blkmom_adv_gq_act___va_ettx&refcode=em22_220812_blkmom_adv_gq_act___va_ettx&source=em22_220812_blkmom_adv_gq_act___va_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220812_blkmom_adv_gq_act___va_ettx&utm_medium=email&contactdata=qR37+Lg8pgurhcoZrtCw2fUORJjXu9Sopqb9DvOVINAmQ/9JKHbgKhX29wE2UnGTraOUPNZ9rNfC7Pl8oRYK6nFW2VLs48vmAQouoqlMQFZi/XLAMZ39rvU9OxJYJk5GMeX/RPh5AcsYBh8Z++yXWduiVe7pR2PVUXF4fvEriGY=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTcwOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNDVlYmRjNC04MTFhLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=e7RxTEWvRpHf5GS-nJz3dW7oUxWqCjLNajob9gR0DXg=&emci=617b9f8d-7b1a-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=145ebdc4-811a-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=5086640)** The disparities between health outcomes for birth-giving people of color and others go back generations and remain today. There is no reason that giving birth should still remain so deadly for Black moms.

As a physician for over twenty years, I saw firsthand how two patients on the same floor of a hospital might be treated differently just because of their race. We must invest in equity for people of color in all our health care centers. We also must invest more funding into community-based services in Black communities and into research that can help us continue to address this critical issue.

But first, we need to prove to our elected officials that reducing Black maternity mortality should be a priority. **[Join me in demanding Congress take action to reduce Black maternity mortality today.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49154227/361023335/-1463453417?ms=em22_220812_blkmom_adv_gq_act___va_ettx&refcode=em22_220812_blkmom_adv_gq_act___va_ettx&source=em22_220812_blkmom_adv_gq_act___va_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220812_blkmom_adv_gq_act___va_ettx&utm_medium=email&contactdata=qR37+Lg8pgurhcoZrtCw2fUORJjXu9Sopqb9DvOVINAmQ/9JKHbgKhX29wE2UnGTraOUPNZ9rNfC7Pl8oRYK6nFW2VLs48vmAQouoqlMQFZi/XLAMZ39rvU9OxJYJk5GMeX/RPh5AcsYBh8Z++yXWduiVe7pR2PVUXF4fvEriGY=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTcwOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNDVlYmRjNC04MTFhLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=e7RxTEWvRpHf5GS-nJz3dW7oUxWqCjLNajob9gR0DXg=&emci=617b9f8d-7b1a-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=145ebdc4-811a-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=5086640)**

Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220812&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220812&amount=28]
Team,
As we get closer to November, the ‘dark money’ in Elissa’s race is starting to pick up. Just yesterday, the Americans for Prosperity (AFP) PAC – backed by the Koch Brothers – invested $71,000 in Elissa’s opponent.
This is just the latest investment in a relationship that goes back to Elissa’s opponent’s first campaign in 2014. During that time, he regularly voted against popular bipartisan bills that his constituents supported, in favor of policies backed by AFP. Here are a few examples:
Most recently were his 6 votes against deals that would bring 8,200 jobs and $9 billion in economic investment to Michigan’s auto industry. 5 of those votes were against an electric vehicle battery plant in his own district. AFP came out against the plant on the day it was announced. The month after Elissa’s opponent voted against the deal, they endorsed his campaign and began supporting him with hundreds of thousands of dollars in ads, literature, and organizers.
Another example: in 2016, the Michigan legislature passed an overwhelmingly bipartisan bill to close a $80 million tax loophole for auto insurance companies. But AFP and the insurance companies opposed the closure of this loophole – and Elissa’s opponent was a leading voice opposing the bipartisan bill, making him one of the few legislators to vote against it twice.
And in 2018, he voted to allow PACs and dark money organizations to hide their donors from the government and from public disclosure. This was part of an effort, spearheaded by AFP, to lobby for similar anti-transparency laws in states across the country. As Elissa’s opponent backed the legislation and successfully pushed to enshrine the Citizens United ruling in state law, AFP put up ads to help him get re-elected to the state legislature.
These examples illustrate the deep contrast between Elissa and her opponent. While his votes align with AFP’s interests – Elissa has pledged to never take a dime of corporate PAC money. She made this promise when she first ran for office because she never wanted her constituents to wonder whose interests she was fighting for – and she’s stuck to it.
In the next few months, the spending in favor of Elissa’s opponent is only going to get worse. Will you contribute today to help us fight back and show that corporate money can’t buy this election? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220812&amount=28]

Friend, Today, many of our leaders are out of touch with their working-class constituents. That won’t be me. I’m a single mom who has worked long hours to put food on the table for me and my son, Ajna. As Governor, I will bring people from historically underrepresented groups to the table and ensure that our state works for all Vermonters. **** Today in Vermont, we’re facing several severe problems that have been ignored by the current administration. We must do more to heal the overdose crisis, bring about bold climate action, and address the housing crisis. We simply can’t afford to keep the status quo. Good enough is not enough. We can do better.

To combat these issues, we need leaders who will put the needs of Vermonters first and be willing and ready to direct their resources to support efforts to make progress. In the past, I’ve delivered for Vermonters. I’ve worked collectively with our legislators to pass life saving legislation to address our housing shortage and start to heal the overdose crisis. I’ll be spending every day of the next three months doing what I’ve always done: fighting for a Vermont that will work for all of us. We can win this race by showing that we have the right solutions. Over the next three months, I’ll work to grow support from Vermonters from every corner of the state. I will be a Governor who works for the needs of all and will be your voice. Asking for money is not fun. It’s my least favorite part about running for office. But we need to create infrastructure to spread our movement across the state. body:
The chaos must end.

| Friend, yesterday, an armed gunman attacked an FBI field office here in Cincinnati.

I am thankful to our local, state, and federal law enforcement officers who kept us all safe yet again.

In the immediate aftermath of the FBI search on Donald Trump’s Mar-A-Lago estate, Rep. Chabot put out a _**fundraising email**_ telling his supporters the Justice Department was a “political weapon of the Left”, and that they should donate to “help get to the bottom of this.” [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49157590/361036401/1664966824?s=20&t=2FsE5cXj6KD0JtgcJ8OtUA&refcode=GLFC_20220812_EMINFO_E1_T0_AC&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDg5NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMjE1MTczZC04YzFhLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DDaSF9oehvVvH0vc5MH1bXx6LGVBw1-JN5jDLOJYiCI=&emci=b500748d-831a-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=0215173d-8c1a-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=10283101) I want to be clear: we still need more information from law enforcement before we know the full story behind the attack and the motivations of the attacker.

**What I do know however, is that this attack came on the heels of a coordinated effort to discredit the FBI by Trump and his supporters, including Chabot. Trump and Chabot continue to incite chaos and violence against our country for political gain. Chabot must put an end to this rhetoric immediately.**

Our democracy cannot survive if we resolve to settle political disputes through violence. It cannot survive if we counter free and fair elections with insurrection. It cannot survive if extremist Republicans continue to spew dangerous, blatantly false rhetoric for their short term political gain.

This election has never been about partisan politics. It’s about Republicans, Democrats, and Independents coming together to end the extremism and dangerous rhetoric that Trump and his allies like Rep. Chabot are peddling.

Folks, Rep. Chabot has placed his loyalty to Donald Trump above all else, and it’s time we held him responsible for abandoning our democracy. Let’s do just that at the ballot box this November.

Thank you,

Greg Landsman

body:
NPR’s priorities are totally out of whack
| | | | |

---
| | | | | Peter, NPR has strange priorities. **By now I’m sure you’ve seen the viral video of Beto O'Rourke responding to a Greg-Abbott supporting heckler as he talked about the somber reality of our children murdered by assault rifles. NPR saw it, and they were outraged ... by Beto swearing.** **_[THANK BETO for saying what must be said, and doing what must be done. Please join us in giving $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to Beto O'Rourke. Because we can't afford 2023 where he is not Governor of Texas.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T9ad26812-a7eb-4bf9-93b0-e3008f506cda/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)_** **_If you're exhausted by Democrats too often refusing to hit back, comment or message aggressively against Republicans who lie, cheat, steal, coup, take away our rights and pocket our taxes, it's a reminder of why we need the next generation of fighters in the Democratic Party to take over, and oh my, is Beto O'Rourke one of those._** Beto was speaking about assault rifles, and how they were weapons made for the battlefield--which every sane human including the creator of the assault rifle has acknowledged--the damage they do to little bodies in schools as they were made to pierce helmets of opposing soldiers. In fetid, disrespectful, and honestly abominable right-wing fashion, as he was talking about children being murdered by assault rifles, he was heckled by a Greg Abbott supporter in the crowd who started laughing.** ** **_Laughing at kids dying via assault rifle. Think about that._** **Then Beto responded the way we all wish we had, not like some polished politician but a real human with real emotions:** **_" It may be funny to you motherf***er but it's not funny to me."_**

| | | Derek,**__**********
****Most days, I start my work at 4:00 AM. I’m on the tractor by 7:00. It may sound rough for most, but this kind of hard work has enabled me to live the American Dream. _And I want to keep that dream alive for future generations._ That’s what I worked to do in the State Senate here in New Hampshire. I said no to liberal Democrat proposals that would raise taxes. I drafted up the most conservative, pro-growth budget in state history. I defended the unborn, gave parents a voice in education, and so much more. **I have a proven record of putting conservative principles to work. And with your help, I’m going to bring these principles to a place that needs them now more than ever...** **I’m talking about Maggie Hassan’s turf: the land of elite Ivy League lawyers who do nothing but put the American Dream out of reach.****_I’m talking about Washington, DC!_**___**[](https://click.mlsend2.com/link/c/YT0yMDE1NTIwMjIyNzA1ODg0MDUzJmM9dzRnNCZlPTAmYj0xMDA0NTU5NjUxJmQ9bDFuM2k3eg==.xYGjRJ3qSmojsxM1IB62ppNbGdOfr3rLawtX4_W-nZI)**_

body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=656%2E5257348%2ELJB_SB ]Adam Schiff for Congress

Democrats are heading toward November with a new confidence, and a deep
record of accomplishments in this Congress that may well be enough to keep
both of our majorities, Derek.

No, this isn’t hyperbole. It’s based on real results.

The House just passed the inflation reduction bill to lower prescription
drug costs and health insurance premiums, and make the largest climate
investment EVER in our nation’s history. And the bill reduces our deficits
by making large corporations pay their fair share in taxes.

Our job now is to take our record of accomplishments and present our case
to the American people. But we only have about 12 weeks to do it, so I
have to ask for your support:

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=aug2022_abs_em.vZ_ypc&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC_20220812_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=656%2E5257348%2ELJB_SB ]Derek, will you please pitch in $10 to our campaign to defend
our Democratic House majority that has accomplished so much in so little
time? We only have 12 weeks to campaign and protect our majority from
Kevin McCarthy and your support makes a real difference.

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately:

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1015?c0=aug2022_abs_em.9pNUzn&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC_20220812_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=656%2E5257348%2ELJB_SB ]EXPRESS DONATE $10

Just take a look at everything we’ve passed:

* A $1.9 trillion rescue package that kept small businesses open, got
Americans vaccinated and saved countless lives
* A $1.2 trillion infrastructure plan to build roads, bridges and
highways
* The first federal gun safety legislation in 30 years
* A big boost to semiconductor manufacturing and jobs at home
* Veterans’ health care expansion
* And now, a bill to lower health care costs, flight climate change and
cut emissions by 40% this decade

That’s not to mention the Senate confirmation of Justice Ketanji Brown
Jackson, the first Black woman to serve as a Supreme Court justice; an
economy with more jobs than we had before the pandemic; record low
unemployment; and the average price of gas below $4 per gallon for the
first time since March.

Derek, we’ve fought for every single inch of progress through
our 50-50 Senate majority, and 4-seat House majority.

Despite Kevin McCarthy and Mitch McConnell’s obstruction.

Now, we have just 12 weeks to make the case to the American people why we
can do even more if we hold onto both the House and Senate.

I know we can do it, Derek. I believe that now more strongly
than ever. But it will take resources to overcome McCarthy and McConnell’s
unprecedented wave of midterm spending.

So I am asking you:

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=aug2022_abs_em.vZ_ypc&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC_20220812_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1011&akid=656%2E5257348%2ELJB_SB ]Will you add your support with a contribution of $10 or any amount that

can keep making progress.

donation will go through immediately:

We’re in the homestretch.

We’ve passed a flurry of bills important to the American people in the
past several weeks — gun safety, veterans health, domestic manufacturing
of semiconductors, lower drug costs, action on climate, and so much more.

We are ready to go out and win this thing, and we are so grateful to every
single one of you who’s in this fight with us.

Thank you,
